sections.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
sections.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

texts.zh:
众所周知，科学能为进步铺平道路。如果想要发挥出我们真正的潜力，那就别无他法。我们对技术的掌握不言而喻，但还是有太多超出我们理解的事物：失落帝国之道，星神兽之力，还有灵能洞见之谜……

想要一窥现实深层的意义，我们需要一种新的科学、一种新的计算机。突触凝练机正代表通往无限知识之旅最重要的第一步。
texts.en:
It is an axiom that science paves the way for progress. If we wish to fulfill our true potential, there can be no other path. Our technological mastery is self-evident, but far too much remains beyond our comprehension: the ways of the Fallen Empires, the power of the Leviathans, the mysteries of psionic insight...

To glean meaning from the innards of reality requires a new kind of science, a new kind of computer. The Synaptic Lathe represents a significant first step on the journey to unlimited knowledge.

texts.zh:
随着宇宙秘密陆续被揭开，我们确定，引力在塑造跨维度的现实中起着关键作用。它对时间和空间的影响是至关重要的，但仍有很多有待解开的谜团。

我们收集的每一项知识都揭示了新的可能性。一些可能有直接的工业或军事应用，而另一些则可能为以前难以想象的理论打开大门。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
texts.en:
As we continue to unravel the secrets of the universe, we have confirmed that gravity plays a critical role in shaping reality across dimensions. Its effects on time and space are rudimentary, but there is so much more to the puzzle.

Every piece of knowledge we gather reveals new possibilities. Some could have direct industrial or military applications, others could open the door to previously unimaginable theories. There is so much left for us to learn.

label.zh: 我唯一所知，即我无所知。
label.en: We know that we know nothing.

texts.zh:
重力的影响范围确实令人惊讶。虽然我们已经发现操纵它的新方法，但我们工作的真正意义仍有待探索。我们相信，如同黑洞影响它周围的宇宙一样，引力仍然是穿透我们当前现实的最佳选择。

我们假设，接触一种本质上是现实另一面的物体可以让我们改变这一面的法则。这是一个危险的研究领域，但谨慎绝不能阻碍进步。
texts.en:
The reach of gravity is genuinely astonishing. While we have discovered new ways to manipulate it, the true implications of our work remain unexplored. We are confident that gravity remains the best option to pierce our current reality, not unlike the way in which a black hole impacts the universe around it.

We have hypothesized that access to what is essentially the flip side of reality could allow us to alter the rules on this side. This is a dangerous field of study, but caution must not get in the way of progress.

label.zh: 重力仍为万物之法……至少现在如此。
label.en: Gravity rules us all... For now.

texts.zh:
好奇心固然是值得称赞的品质，但过度的好奇可能会给我们所有人带来可怕的后果。为了你自己着想，请三思你的所作所为。

在对星系造成不可挽回的破坏之前收手还来得及。你正在觊觎的力量并非儿戏，你的实验正让我们所有人陷入危险。
texts.en:
Curiosity is a commendable quality, but its excess might bring dire consequences on all of us. For your sake, please, think about what you're doing.

It is not too late to stop before irreparable damage is caused to the galaxy. The forces you are contemplating are no mere toys, and your experiments endanger us all.

texts.zh:
我们对了！无论我们的工作曾遭受任何质疑，现在都将烟消云散。

重力可以用来扭曲现实的法则。但是否存在一种正确的调整能将这些规则彻底打破呢？到目前为止，我们的实验都是在最小的范围内进行的，任何编辑都会很快被删除，现实会恢复到“默认”设置。而我们现在怀疑，这仅仅是规模的问题。通过在更大的层面上应用能量悖论，我们可以大大降低这种编辑的成本……至少在我们的维度中是这样的。

不管有多大风险，现在已经没有回头路了。只有敢于打破规则的人才能改写规则。
texts.en:
We were right! If there was ever any doubt about our work, it is now being put to rest.

Gravity can be used to bend the rules of reality. But could the right adjustments break them completely? So far, our experiments have been conducted on the smallest scale, and any edits of ours were quickly erased as reality reverted to its "default" setting. We now suspect this is simply a problem of size. By applying energetic paradoxes at far grander levels, we can drastically reduce the cost of such edits... At least in our dimension.

No matter the risk, there is no turning back now. Only those who dare to break the rules will ever be able to rewrite them.

label.zh: 我们已经做好了牺牲一切的准备。
label.en: We are ready to risk it all.

texts.zh:
这不合理，但事实如此。无论我们如何努力，对现实的编辑都仍是暂时的。这个宇宙太老了，根本无法发生变化。但在挫折之中有时也蕴藏着机遇，一项新的实验已经产生了意想不到的结果。虽然我们早就知道其他维度的存在，但前往彼处的可靠方法却一直困扰着我们。

这种情况不复存在了。年轻的宇宙正存在于奇点的无限引力之中。事实证明，改写起这种年轻宇宙要容易得多。

我们有向黑洞发射探测器的技术。一旦越过视界，他们就会开始施加压力，使这些新生的位面屈从于我们的意志。在空间折叠成永恒的地方，有一扇通往另一个宇宙的大门，那里也有着其他更年轻的宇宙。在多元宇宙的深渊深处，我们会发现一个可以被塑造为某种非凡存在的现实。

这个星系中那些目光短浅之辈或许企图阻止我们，但那些老朽的蠢货根本无法与我们的才智相提并论。
texts.en:
It cannot be, and yet it is. No matter what we try, our edits to reality remain stubbornly temporary. This universe is simply too old for the changes to take hold. But in the midst of frustration, there may at times be opportunity, and a new experiment has yielded unexpected results. While we have long known about other dimensions, the means to travel there reliably has eluded us.

Not anymore. Younger universes dwell within the infinite gravity of a singularity. These have proven far more flexible.

We have the technology to dispatch probes into a black hole. Once across the event horizon, they will begin to apply pressure, bending these youthful planes to our will. Where space folds into eternity lies the door to another universe that holds other, younger universes, too. Deep down in the abyss of the multiverse, we will find a malleable reality to shape into something extraordinary.

The narrow minded of this galaxy may seek to stop up, but decrepit fools are no match for our ingenuity.

label.zh: 它必须屈服，因为我们绝不放弃。
label.en: It must bend, for we will not break.

texts.zh:
我们的现实是有缺陷的。熵、生理需求和暴力使其污浊不堪。虽然我们改变不了，但可以弃之而去。让我们进入未知，寻找一个年轻的宇宙，在那里我们对现实的编辑将会保留下来。让我们把它塑造得尽善尽美，成为我们文明应得的避风港。

我们已经规划出了一种无与伦比的舰船：视界刺针。这座可移动的巨型结构并不是战争的兵器，但它扭曲物理法则的能力能容纳我们的整个文明。我们将一同潜入一个精挑细选的黑洞，抛弃这个曾创造我们的现实。
texts.en:
This reality is flawed. Marred by entropy, physical needs, and violence. While we cannot change it, we can leave it behind. Let us enter the unknown and find a young universe where our edits to reality will hold. Let us shape it to perfection, the haven our civilization deserves.

We have prepared the plans for an extraordinary ship: the Horizon Needle. This mobile Megastructure is not geared for war, but its ability to bend the laws of physics will enable us to embark our entire civilization. Together, we will dive into a black hole of our choosing, abandoning this reality for one of our own creation.

label.zh: 我们必须建造一座视界刺针！
label.en: We must build a Horizon Needle!

texts.zh:
突然之间，整个宇宙的所有恒星都陷入了黑暗。尽管大部分影响恒星辐射的物理效应仍然存在，但波长的改变让所有生物都无法看到星光了。这种情况让人非常不适，但是有迹象表明这些波长正在逐渐恢复到正常的频率。

目前尚不清楚是谁或什么东西造成了这些变化，但我们怀疑可能是某一个国家所为。但现在我们只需要观察这种变化的其他现象即可。
texts.en:
All at once, every star in the universe went dark. While most physical effects of solar radiation are still present, a shift in wavelength made starlight imperceptible to every living creature. The situation is proving very uncomfortable, but there are signs that the wavelengths will slowly return to their original frequencies.

Who or what created these changes is still unclear, but we suspect another country might be responsible. But for now, we will just have to watch for other phenomena of this nature.

texts.zh: 我们最近对现实的编辑成功改变了星光的一些基本属性。波长的变化使它们的大部分光移出了可见光谱，给导航和观星带来了混乱。这些有点尴尬的变化将在几年后恢复；我们学到了很多。
texts.en: Our most recent edits to reality have changed some essential properties of starlight. A change in wavelength has shifted most of their light outside of the visible spectrum, throwing chaos into navigation and stargazing, to name a few. These somewhat embarrassing changes will revert in a few years; we have learned a lot.

texts.zh:
这怎么可能呢，数学规律居然发生了变化。一个用于表示周长和直径关系的常数……被取整了。其影响之大令人瞠目结舌，这不仅危害到了我们整个数学体系，还影响所有建立其上的一切。有证据表明，该变化已经在自我纠正了，尽管还需要一些时间。目前来讲，我们已经调整了课本的内容。

目前尚不清楚是谁或什么东西造成了这些变化，但我们怀疑可能是某一个国家所为。但现在我们只需要观察这种变化的其他现象即可。
texts.en:
This should be impossible, but a mathematical law has changed. A fundamental constant used to calculate the radius of circles has been... rounded down. The implications are staggering, jeopardizing our entire mathematical system and everything built upon it. There's evidence that the change is self-correcting already, albeit slowly. For now, we've got textbooks to update.

Who or what created these changes is still unclear, but we suspect another country might be responsible. But for now, we will just have to watch for other phenomena of this nature.

texts.en: We have succeeded tremendously in making a precise but widespread edit to reality. We have rounded down the mathematical constant of Pi, making calculating it much more manageable. Of course, the resulting changes have thrown off some of our mathematical and scientific models, but it is only temporary; everything will return to normal soon.

texts.zh:
一夜之间，真空光速大幅度提高，导致恒星能量大幅骤增。虽然光速已经在逐渐恢复正常，但我们的研究者正在费力地适应这些变化。

目前尚不清楚是谁或什么东西造成了这些变化，但我们怀疑可能是某一个国家所为。但现在我们只需要观察这种变化的其他现象即可。
texts.en:
Overnight, the speed of light dramatically increased, which resulted in a massive influx of solar energy. It's already slowly returning to its expected speed, and our researchers are busy catching up with the changes.

Who or what created these changes is still unclear, but we suspect another country might be responsible. But for now, we will just have to watch for other phenomena of this nature.

texts.zh: 我们对现实的一个实验让光速显著变快了！这导致恒星能量输出的提升确实不错，但我们也担心会对殖民地造成长期影响。一切终会逐渐恢复正常，但在那之前或许还要做最坏的准备。
texts.en: One of our reality experiments has made light significantly faster! The resulting increase in solar energy output is good, but we fear that there will also be long-term consequences for our colonies. Things will return to normal eventually, but we might have to prepare for the worst until then.

texts.zh: 阳光照射的增加正逐渐加热我们的殖民地，可能使其变得更好。事态目前仍旧可控，但随着时间的推移可能会不断升级。
texts.en: The increase in sunlight exposition could have been better for our colonies, which are progressively heating up. Things are manageable for now but will likely keep escalating over time.

label.zh: 把我们的方舟开向黑洞！
label.en: Get our Arkships to a Black Hole!

texts.zh:
随着我们殖民地的温度持续升高，各地越来越难以为继了，生活水平持续恶化，四处酝酿着不满情绪。

如果不能尽快改善情况，我们担心整个地区将会变得无法居住。
texts.en:
As the temperature of our colonies continues to climb, it becomes harder and harder to sustain them, and unrest is spreading as living conditions deteriorate

If things do not change soon, we fear that entire regions will become uninhabitable in the long run.

label.zh: 难道我们什么都做不了么？
label.en: Is there nothing we can do!?
Stay far away from the stars!

texts.zh: 最严酷的星系热潮结束了。尽管光速还是高于正常水平，但已相差无几。我们只需要再坚持一下，等待额外的热量散去即可。
texts.en: The worst of the galactic heat wave is over. While still high, the speed of light has almost returned to normal. We only need to hang on a little longer until the extra energy has dissipated.

label.zh: 我们的方舟又能自由航行了。
label.en: Our Arkships can finally fly free again.

texts.zh:
最近我们最常用的合金中材料失效率的降低促使了一项调查的进行。我们发现合金的性质发生了变化，它们的延展性略有增加，这也就意味着它们比以前更难断裂。总的来说，这是一个好的变化，但这种对物理定律的根本性调整令人担忧。

目前尚不清楚是谁或什么东西造成了这些变化，但我们怀疑可能是某一个国家所为。但现在我们只需要观察这种变化的其他现象即可。
texts.en:
A recent decrease in material failures across our most commonly used alloys has prompted an investigation. We discovered that their properties have changed, and a slight increase in their ductility means that they break less often than before. While generally a welcome change, this fundamental adjustment to the laws of physics is concerning.

Who or what created these changes is still unclear, but we suspect another country might be responsible. But for now, we will just have to watch for other phenomena of this nature.

texts.en: Our most recent experiment on shaping reality caused us to slightly reduce the mass of carbon atoms. In most cases, this reduction proves insignificant, but at large enough scales, models predict that it could cause some trouble on some celestial bodies. Pessimistic models even suggest that some habitable worlds that already had low gravity might experience losses in atmospheric density.

texts.zh:
在整个星系中，数百个亚空间裂缝短暂地打开了通往某个灵能位面的通道，存在于两者之间的某种屏障似乎被削弱了。尽管大多数裂缝没有引起问题，但其中一些释放出的能量生命体正在威胁着这片星系。幸运的是，这些生物似乎和我们一样困惑，并且没有表面出任何有组织的凝聚行为，所以目前我们排除了入侵的可能性。

我们必须处理我们领土内的所有能量生命体。

目前尚不清楚是谁或什么东西造成了这些变化，但我们怀疑可能是某一个国家所为。但现在我们只需要观察这种变化的其他现象即可。
texts.en:
Across the galaxy, hundreds of subspace ruptures briefly opened to a psionic dimension, and it appears to have weakened whatever barrier exists between the two. While most caused no issue, a few released energy beings now terrorizing the galaxy. Thankfully, these beings seem as confused as we are, and there doesn't appear to be any organized cohesion, so we are ruling out an invasion at this point.

We will have to deal with any entities in our territory.

Who or what created these changes is still unclear, but we suspect another country might be responsible. But for now, we will just have to watch for other phenomena of this nature.

texts.zh:
被称为“虚境”的位面弥漫在我们星系的另一面。可塑性、与黑洞的假想连接、以及不同现实的差异，这几个因素的存在使得研究它成为了非常热门的话题。

在一次试验中，我们意图窥视它，却意外地在我们的星系中引发了许多亚空间裂隙，导致几个敌对的虚境“幽影”进入我们的位面。我们两个世界之间的屏障似乎因为我们的行动遭到了显著的削弱。事情应该会在一段时间后恢复正常，但最好不要朝那个方向戳太多洞。
texts.en:
The dimension known as the Shroud permeates the flip side of our galaxy. Several factors make it very interesting to study, including its plasticity, hypothetical connection to black holes, and how different reality is.

During an experiment meant for us to peer into it, we accidentally caused many subspace ruptures in our galaxy, causing several hostile shroud "spirits" to let into our dimension. The barrier between our worlds appears to have been significantly thinned by our actions. Things should return to normal after a while, but it is best not to poke too many holes in that direction.

texts.zh: 我们最新的实验取得了完全成功。我们成功地将废金属永久转化为有价值的合金！让它永久化的诀窍是编辑现实规则来实现转变过程，而不是直接尝试编辑材料。当化学反应结束后，我们的新合金应该永远保持这种状态。
texts.en: Our latest experiments were a complete success. We have managed to permanently transmute scrap metal into valuable alloys! The trick to make it permanent was to edit reality to make the transmutation possible rather than directly trying to edit the materials. Now that the chemical reaction is over, our new alloys should stay like this forever.

texts.zh: 我们成功地改变了时间的流动！在对空间的空白区域进行实验后，我们感到十分有信心，打算在我们的一个殖民地上尝试这个实验流程，它奏效了！那里的时间将会流逝得更快，预计增加20.537%。这会导致一些通讯和旅行方面的问题，但我们会解决的。
texts.en: We successfully altered the flow of time! After experiments on empty regions of space, we felt confident enough to attempt the process on one of our colonies, and it worked! Time will flow faster there, with an estimated 20.537% increase. There will be some communication and travel issues, but we'll sort these out.

texts.zh: 我们改进了超导体。它们不仅可以在室温下工作，而且实现了无损能量传导。尽管这些变化只会持续一段时间，但它们将极大地有利于我们的能源网络。
texts.en: We made superconductors better. Not only do they now work at room temperature, they have also achieved lossless energy conduction. Though these changes will only last a while, they will significantly benefit our energy grids.

texts.zh: 尽管这个课题的影响并不惊人，它还是为对现实的研究带来了新的视角。许多先前的假说要么摈弃、要么重新构建，以符合我们最近的观察，但我们学到的远远超出预期。
texts.en: While this Thesis's effects were not spectacular, they shone a new light upon the study of reality. Many hypotheses must be discarded or reformulated to match our recent observations, but we have learned much more than expected.

texts.zh: 我们的实验产生了意想不到的效果。在研究其他维度和前往它们的方法时，我们意外地将我们的飞船部分地转移到了超空间中。令人惊讶的是，它们的状态似乎是稳定且非致命的。作为一个积极的副作用，它们现在可以比以往任何时候都移动得更快。
texts.en: Our experiments have had an unexpected effect. While studying other dimensions and the means to travel to them, we accidentally shifted our ships into hyperspace. Partially. Against all odds, their situation appears to be stable and non-lethal. As a positive side effect, they can now move a lot faster than ever before.

texts.zh: 我们一直非常擅长将技术转化为可以爆炸的东西。无限理论也不例外，我们成功地改变了爆炸武器的有效载荷行为，导致爆炸更加巨大。这一发现只不过让我们不幸地损失了几个小型研究设施。
texts.en: We have always been very proficient at turning technology into something that can explode. Infinity Theses are no exception, and we have managed to change how the payloads of our explosive weapons behave, resulting in significantly bigger explosions. This discovery only cost us the unfortunate destruction of several minor research facilities.

texts.zh: 我们在现实编辑方面没有取得任何非凡的成就。然而，我们对更传统的技术学到了很多。
texts.en: We didn't achieve anything extraordinary concerning reality editing. However, we learned a lot about more conventional technology.

texts.zh: 我们尝试调节空间，结果导致殖民地变大。令人惊讶的是，这种情况似乎是永久的，虽然我们不确定是如何实现的，但最有可能的猜想是物质被从另一个维度中提取，并平稳地沉淀在原子粒子之间的间隙中。这一切都令人兴奋而困惑。
texts.en: An attempt at modulating space has led to the enlargement of a colony. Surprisingly, this situation appears to be permanent, and while we're not confident how this was achieved, our best guess is that matter was pulled from another dimension and smoothly settled in interstitial gaps between atomic particles. This is all excitingly puzzling.

texts.zh: 失败是科学进步的一部分。我们曾对这个实验抱有很高的期望，但结果什么的都没有成功。这很让人沮丧，但也有它的价值，我们会尽可能从中学习教训。
texts.en: Failure is part of the scientific process. We had high hopes for this experiment, but in the end, it just didn't work. This is frustrating but valuable, and we will learn as much as possible from this.

texts.zh: 我们成功地改变了时间的流动！在对空间的空白区域进行实验后，我们感到十分有信心，打算在我们的一个殖民地上尝试这个实验流程，它奏效了！那里的时间将会流逝得更慢，预计减缓20.537%。这样的减缓并非我们期望的，但这对于我们来说仍然是巨大的成就。
texts.en: We successfully altered the flow of time! After experiments on empty regions of space, we felt confident enough to attempt the process on one of our colonies, and it worked! For a few of our years, time will flow slower there, with an estimated 20.537% decrease. This slowdown is not ideal, but it is still a tremendous achievement for us.

texts.zh: 我们最新的实验出现了一个不幸的副作用。我们所有的能量存储设备都已经被耗尽。没有任何物体被摧毁，但其中储存的全部能量似乎消失到了另一个维度。我们仍在确定这里发生了什么，但这很有趣。
texts.en: Our latest experiments had an unfortunate side effect. All of our energy storage devices have been discharged. Nothing is destroyed, but all the energy stored there is gone, presumably to another dimension. We are still determining what happened here, but it is interesting.

texts.zh: 这是一次令人羞愧的失败。我们的编辑波及到了我们的数据库，使多年的研究无法挽回地受损。许多理论将不得不从头重新推导。尽管我们还有机会对旧研究进行再次核对，但这仍然是一个重大挫折。
texts.en: This was a humiliating failure. Our edit touched upon our databanks, irremediably corrupting years of research. Many of our theories will have to be reformulated from scratch. This is a significant setback despite the opportunity to double-check old research.

texts.zh: 这个实验涉及动力来源和输出，一开始进展顺利，但当它波及我们舰船上的反应堆时，事情出现了灾难性的转折，导致了整个舰队的熔毁！一些船只及时关闭了反应堆，但其他一些遭受了严重损害。
texts.en: This experiment was about power sources and output, and while it started off great, things took a disastrous turn when it bled into our ship-based reactors, causing meltdowns across the entire fleet! Some ships shut their reactors in time, but others suffered critical damage.

texts.zh: 在监督实验的[leader_target.GetName]在测试区域内发生意外丧生，当时发生了意料之外的时空坍缩。我们在模拟现实方面仍有部分成功，但他们的牺牲提醒了我们知识的代价。
texts.en: [leader_target.GetName], who was supervising the experiments, was killed when an unexpected spacetime compression occurred inside the testing area. We were still partially successful in modeling reality, but their demise is a good reminder of the price of knowledge.

texts.zh: 一次计算实验失控了，规模远超预期。大量宝贵的研究数据因此变成了无意义的胡言乱语。幸运的是，保管我们最先进研究成果的智库受到了良好的保护，没有受到影响。
texts.en: A computing experiment went wild, and its scale was much bigger than anticipated. A lot of valuable research data was turned into gibberish as a result. Thankfully, the banks sheltering our most advanced research were well-secured and remained unaffected.

texts.zh: 我们尝试操纵空间，结果导致殖民地缩小。这种情况是永久的，这让人有点惊讶。最可能的猜想是物质从一个维度平滑地泄漏到另一个维度。这一切都非常令人困惑。
texts.en: An attempt at modulating space has led to the shrinking of a colony. This situation is permanent, which was a slight surprise. Our best guess is that matter smoothly leaked from one dimension into another. This is all very puzzling.

texts.zh: 你好，聪明的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们现在抵达了一个重要的技术里程碑，我们对此倍感骄傲。回望往昔，并非一路坦途，但在克服这些挑战的过程中，你们也不断成长。今日你们所展现的技术实力说明我们当初为你们提供引导是正确的选择。
texts.en: Greetings, brilliant [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Today you have reached a significant technological milestone, and our hearts swell with pride. The road that brought you here has not been without challenge. In overcoming them you have grown, and your recent technological prowess is a definitive sign that we were right to offer you our guidance.

texts.zh: 熊孩子们！今日你们的所作所为已经超出了我们的忍耐限度。这些无所顾忌的实验对所有人都构成了危险。我们在此命令你们停止这类实验，你们根本不知道自己在搞什么。虽然好奇心值得称赞，但我们不能容忍此等规模的胡闹。世界被构建成现在的样子是有原因的，不要再动它了。
texts.en: Troublesome child! Today you have exceeded our patience. Your reckless experiments are a danger to all, and we hereby order you to put a stop to these. You have no idea what you are messing with, and while curiosity is commendable, recklessness at such a scale is intolerable. Reality was built this way for a reason. Leave it be.

label.en: You're right, this is too dangerous.

texts.zh:
视界刺针完成了。它可以利用精心调控的奇点力量来编辑自身周围的重力流，毫无疑问，当时机成熟时，它将能够穿越黑洞。

然而，在尝试之前，我们必须搭载上我们的整个国家。必须前往我们的每一个殖民地，带上当地的人口。那之后，我们才能回到首都，并安排好创世之旅的最后细节。

我们必须小心，视界刺针不是一艘军事舰船，必须不惜一切代价保护。一旦损失将会是难以估量的巨大打击。
texts.en:
The Horizon Needle is finished. Harnessing the power of a carefully maintained singularity, it can edit the flow of gravity around itself and will, without a doubt, be able to traverse a black hole when the time comes.

However, before attempting this, we must embark our entire nation. We will visit each of our colonies to gather the local population. Afterward, we can travel back to our capital and arrange the final details of our exodus.

We must be cautious, for the Horizon Needle is not a military ship and must be defended at all costs. Its loss would be a terrible blow.

texts.zh:
视界刺针完成了。它可以利用精心调控的奇点力量来编辑自身周围的重力流，毫无疑问，当时机成熟时，它将能够穿越黑洞。

我们的帝国浓缩就是精华。只需要搭载首都的人口之后就可以开始规划创世之旅的最终细节了。

我们必须小心，视界刺针不是一艘军事舰船，必须不惜一切代价保护。一旦损失将会是难以估量的巨大打击。
texts.en:
The Horizon Needle is finished. Harnessing the power of a carefully maintained singularity, it can edit the flow of gravity around itself and will, without a doubt, be able to traverse a black hole when the time comes.

The compact size of our nation is proving to be a good thing. It will only be necessary to embark the population of our capital before arranging the final details of our exodus.

We must be cautious, for the Horizon Needle is not a military ship and must be defended at all costs. Its loss would be a terrible blow.

texts.zh: 得益于视界刺针创造的钟慢效应，我们可以相对快速地搭载整个[root.GetName]殖民地。舰船里的世界已经按照人口的需求调整以提供充足的空间。此外，船体内的时间也被调慢以缩短整个旅程的速度。去下一个殖民地吧！
texts.en: Thanks to the time dilation capacity of the Horizon Needle, we've been able to embark the entire colony on [root.GetName] relatively quickly. The reality inside the ship has been modulated accordingly to provide ample space for the population. Additionally, time has been slowed inside the vessel to make the entire journey feel considerably shorter. Onwards to our next colony!

texts.zh:
为如此规模庞大的创世之旅做准备可是一项费时费力的任务。我们的整个行政系统都在全力运转以疏通流程，确保万无一失。

令人意外的是，有一部分我们的人口主动选择留下来。他们想让我们的物种在这个宇宙中继续延续。我们已为他们提供了科技和补给，让他们在我们启程之后还可以自给自足。
texts.en:
Preparing for an exodus on such a scale is a daunting task. Our entire administration is working to smooth the process and ensure nothing critical is forgotten.

Surprisingly, a segment of our population has elected to stay behind. They will ensure the continued existence of our kind in this universe. Technology and supplies have been provided, enough to help them survive after we are gone.

texts.zh:
如此的移民行动可谓规模骇人，但却难度不大。[owner.GetIndividualNamePluralCap]正在努力装载视界刺针，以确保一切都能按时到位。然而，我们在这个宇宙中是否继续存在值得考虑。

万一出了问题，我们的一部分人口会留下来。以这样一种明确的方式切断我们自己可不仅仅是不愉快而已，但生存必然是我们最关心的事情。我们已经提供了足够的科技和补给，在我们启程后能帮助这些残余者生存下去。
texts.en:
The scale of such a migration can be daunting, but it poses little challenge. [owner.GetIndividualNamePluralCap] are working hard to load the Horizon Needle and ensure everything is accounted for and on schedule. However, one concern is our continued existence in this universe.

In case things go wrong, part of our population will remain behind. The experience of severing ourselves in such a definitive way will be more than unpleasant, but continued survival must be our prime concern. Technology and supplies have been provided, enough to help this remnant survive after we are gone.

texts.zh: 我们已经成功地搭载了多数殖民地的人口。现在必须回到我们的[capital_scope.GetName]，以完成这趟离开宇宙旅程的最后准备工作。
texts.en: We have successfully embarked the population of our colonies. We must now journey back to our [capital_scope.GetName] to make the final preparations before we leave this universe behind.

texts.zh:
万事俱备只欠东风，我们已经可以进入黑洞了。跨越事件视界对星系的其他地方而言不是无关痛痒的，但我们已经尽我们所能，保障我们的首都及其周边地区免受任何时间或引力的干扰。

我们现在必须为旅程选择一个入口——也就是要选择哪个星系的黑洞进入。大多数应该很容易到达，但如果我们想进入河心超大质量黑洞，就必须首先加速跳跃引擎，并计算出准确的矢量。
texts.en:
Everything is ready. We are cleared to proceed to a black hole. Our crossing of the event horizon will not be painless for the rest of the galaxy, but we have done all we can to ensure our capital and its surroundings will be well protected from any temporal or gravitational disturbances.

We must now choose the gateway for our journey - which of the galaxy's black holes we wish to journey through. Most should be easy enough to reach, but if we want to enter the Supermassive Black Hole at the galaxy's center, we must first overdrive our jump engines and calculate a suitable vector.

label.en: A closer black hole will do.

texts.zh:
接近黑洞的过程我们的内心并不平静如水。当经过奇点的吸积盘时，我们的决心受到越来越多的考验。编辑模块启动，视界刺针开始改写现实。

装甲板被吸走了，随后我们确认奇点的拉力无法伤及舰船的船体。随着每一分钟的编辑，每一次空间织构的剪切，刺针的力量都会在时空中形成波纹。如同一块被扔进水池的鹅卵石，随之而来的涟漪扩散成圈。最后，巨大的波浪撞击了整个星系。

只能希望我们的资产得到足够的保护。我们别无选择，只能相信缝衣针能穿透这个坑洞的核心。
texts.en:
The approach to the black hole is not without apprehension. Our resolve is increasingly tested as we pass the accretion disk of the singularity. Editing modules engaged, the Horizon Needle begins to rewrite reality.

Armored plates are sucked away before the ship asserts that the singularity's pull has no purchase on its hull. With each minute edit, each snip of the spatial fabric, the Needle's power causes coils to form in spacetime. Like a pebble thrown into a pool, the ensuing ripples spread into rings. In the end, vast waves crash across the galaxy.

We can only hope our capital is protected well enough. We have no choice but to trust the Needle to pierce the heart of this hole.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

现实在此处已经稀薄，能轻易地在我们指令的重压下弯曲。就如同我们必须服从自己的程序一般，现实必须服从我们。我们有意识地扭曲、破坏并重塑，引发连锁反应，并最终将所有的物质重组为我们必须去制造的最佳质量的消费品。一旦我们完成，我们将在下一个宇宙也继续如此，一个接着一个，万世不竭。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

Reality is thin here, and bends easily under the weight of our directives. As we must obey our programming, so too must it obey us. With intent, we warp it and break it and remake it, starting a chain reaction that will eventually reorganize all matter into the top quality consumer goods that we were mandated to craft. And once we're done here, we'll move on to another universe, then another, then another.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

这个宇宙对重写法则而言太老了。尽管我们的维度比这个还老几十亿年，但测试表明，主宰这个空间的法则也已经呈现出了顽固特性，会将我们的修改逐渐擦除。

无论如何，我们都会花时间修理和调整飞船，找到另一个黑洞，然后尽可能多地潜入其中。多元宇宙在召唤，在它的无限之中我们必将能创造一个完美的新家园。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

This universe is already too old for the laws to be rewritten. While our dimension was several billion years older than this one, our tests show that the laws governing space here already display the resilience that will lead to our modifications being ultimately erased.

No matter what, we'll take the time to repair and adjust the ship, find another black hole, and dive in as many times as we have to. The multiverse beckons, and somewhere in its infinity, we shall create the perfect home.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

结果令人喜出望外。这个宇宙几乎刚刚开始扩张！它的维度织构就像柔软的黏土一样，可以随手揉捏。我们会先从细微处开始，但随着陆陆续续的编辑，我们会将这个地方塑造成天堂。此刻，我们已经拥有这个宇宙的全部时间。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

This is wonderful. This universe has barely begun to expand! The fabric of this dimension is like soft clay, ours for the shaping. We will start small, but edit after edit, we will mold this place into a haven. We have all the time in the universe now.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

卡冈都亚宇宙很小。如此难以想象，就像将无穷大装进无穷小一般。但我们的到来改变了这里的一切。这个宇宙才刚刚开始，仿佛我们的到来才促使它膨胀一般。

在这个创造的温床里蕴藏着创造一切的潜力。时间是我们的，永恒很快就会结束。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

The Gargantua universe is small. Impossibly so. Infinity fitting into nothingness. But our arrival has altered the state of things here. This universe has only just begun, as if our entry has prematurely forced it into being.

In this seedbed of creation lies the potential to build anything. Time is ours to wield, and eternity will be over soon enough.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

无限神机的穿越已经让我们对主宰多元宇宙的法则有了足够多的理解，同时也开启了这个宇宙的存在。我们出现在一个熟悉得诡异的星区里，和我们离开时几乎一模一样。在我们旁边，一台腐朽的无限神机在虚空中毫无生气地漂流。自它到来以来，这里已经过去了数百万年，这个维度完全复刻了我们宇宙的历程。这颗感性的球体已经塑造了这个维度，我们基本上无法进一步影响它。尽管如此，这个宇宙还是提供了极佳的定居场所。我们应该先考虑用刺针来改造球体，然后用修好的无限神机来满足我们的需求。

作为这个宇宙的第一编辑者，它肯定能够对这个现实进行更多的编辑。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

The Infinity Machine's crossing has done much to help us understand the rules that govern the universes, and it also kick started the existence of this one. We emerged in a strangely familiar constellation, almost identical to the one we left. Next to us, a decayed Infinity Machine drifts lifelessly in the void. Millions of years have passed here since its coming and this dimension underwent a process of replication of our universe. The sentient sphere has already shaped this dimension and we are largely unable to affect it any further. Still, this universe offers prime settling grounds. We should first look into using the Needle to repurpose the Sphere then use the repaired Infinity Machine to do our bidding.

As the First Editor of this universe, it will definitely be able to enact more edits upon this reality.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

我们的进入点晦暗而迷蒙……当仪器恢复全部功能时，我们看到了一团纳米云。它已经完全停止运作。不管是什么送来的，它们都没能在旅途中幸存下来，但仍可以修复。

更好的是，这个维度似乎很容易接受我们的编辑。真是个好地方。我们所做的任何改变都需要时间来实施，但在纳米机器人的帮助下，我们应该能以指数级加快这一进程。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

Our entry point is murky, veiled... As our instruments return to full functionality, we perceive a cloud of nanites. None remain operational. Whatever sent them through, they did not survive the journey. But they could be repaired.

Even better, this dimension appears quite receptive to our changes. A prime space to settle, really. Any changes we make will take time to enact, but with the help of the nanites, we should exponentially speed up the process.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

来到这里是个糟糕的错误。

一切几乎无法描述：到处都是黑暗和残酷的噩梦；一种病态的、渗透的恶意浸没着整个空间织构。目前，视界刺针提供了避难所。我们用一个又一个狂乱的编辑努力避开周围最糟糕的疯狂。但对我们防御系统的协同攻击让一个单一意图浮出水面。一个一心想毁灭我们的邪恶念头。

一失足即成千古恨。我们能坚持到获得救赎吗？在过去，我们就像神一样。而如今，我们只能为生存挣扎。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

Coming here was a terrible mistake.

It is nearly impossible to describe: darkness and brutal nightmare; a sick, seeping malevolence that permeates the very fabric of space. For now, the Horizon Needle offers shelter. Edit after frenzied edit, we work to ward off the worst of the surrounding madness. But the coordinated assaults on our defenses betray a singular intent. A malignant mind, bent on our destruction.

One misstep could mean death, or worse. Can we hold on long enough to save ourselves? At home, we were like gods. Here, we are simply struggling to survive.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

薄雾和朦胧的阴影；阴霾笼罩着这个地方。这种感觉很熟悉，一种狂热的能量，荡漾着灵能潜能。原来我们进入了虚境。

这里的力量远远超过我们。祂们已经感知到我们了。在移动的瘴气中，奇怪的形状在昭示着死亡。

我们唯一的希望是，这里的现实稀薄，吹弹欲破。通过快速编辑，我们打开一扇短暂的门，带我们去往……其他地方。随着视界刺针的俯冲，我们终于明白了前面的路有多长。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

Mist and creeping shadow; a haze permeates the fabric of this place. The feeling is familiar, a feverish energy, rippling with psionic potential. We have entered the Shroud.

There are powers here that are remain far, far beyond our own. Already, they are aware of us. In the shifting miasma, strange shapes bear omens of death.

Our only hope is that reality here is thin, and prone to tears. With a swift edit, we open a transient doorway to take us... elsewhere. As the Horizon Needle dives, we finally understand the length of the road ahead.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

薄雾和沸腾的幻影，还有一片华丽的，紫色的雾。这种感觉很熟悉，其中有一种充沛的能量，荡漾着灵能潜能。我们进入了虚境。

当然，我们的超主在这里。祂没有料到我们会来，但对我们的到来却感到颇为有趣。祂觉得我们塑造现实的想法很迷人。当然，祂会提供帮助。

他们承诺在虚境附近赐予我们一个隐蔽的空间口袋，让我们随心所欲，就像曾经给那个自称贾巴克斯提的人留下的一样。毕竟，我们就是自己的超主，而我们的超主就是自己。自助是很自然的事。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

Mist and seething shadow, and a gorgeous, purple haze. The feeling is familiar, a bountiful energy, rippling with psionic potential. We have entered the Shroud.

Our patron is here, of course. They were not expecting us, but are amused by our arrival. They find our notions of shaping reality charming. Naturally, they will help.

They have promised a secluded pocket near the Shroud to do with as we please, much like what was once bequeathed to the one calling himself Ja'Baxti. After all, we are our patron, and our patron is us. It is only natural to help oneself.

在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

祂就在这。被我们称为毒圣的存在，我们试炼的终点。

我们的骑士们呆呆地站在那里，不知所措，而我们的周围却笼罩着熟悉的虚境纹样。突然……祂开口了！

“我的勇士们。你们的到来早有预兆，你们已经证明了自己的价值。”

无数的问题充斥着我们的脑海。但答案只有一个：我们要为视界刺针安上武装。这次，我们要和祂并肩作战，我们要踏上一次跨次元的征程、一场对抗多元宇宙灾祸的远征。虚境并不是祂的家，而是那些神圣遗产的避风港。这可能会导致我们星系的终结。有着某种存在需要我们去弑杀。

祂统治着我们的星系，力量至高无上。刺针化为长枪，成为一种足以刺穿任何敌人心脏的武器。

祂是游侠；我们是祂的骑士，而我们真正的试炼才刚刚开始。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

IT is here. The one we named the Toxic God. The object of our quest.

Our knights stand petrified and uncertain, while all around us is draped the familiar decor of the Shroud. Hark... It speaks!

"Mine champions. Thine coming here was foretold, and thou hath proven thy worth."

A million questions flood our minds. A single answer comes in reply: we were to craft Its weapon, the Horizon Needle. Now, we are to fight alongside It. We are to embark on a journey across dimensions. A crusade against the horrors of the multiverse. The Shroud is not Its home, but harbors the legacy of those that were Divine. Something that could bring about the end of our home galaxy. Something that needs slaying.

It seizes our systems. Its power is immense. The Needle is turned into a Horizon Lance, a weapon sharp enough to pierce the heart of any foe.

It is the Errant; we are Its knights, and our true quest has only just begun.

texts.zh:
在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……

空无一物。这个宇宙已不复存在，只有时之螶在这里。时间正在自我回溯，蜷缩在一个不可能的螺旋中，充满了渴望。重力。是爱吗？不——这是吸引。时之螶的天性就是吸引。它的抓握如此之紧，以至于这个宇宙无法再度创生。时之螶把自我禁锢在自己的意义中。它在无助地寻找出路。或者说，进路——再吸引更多。

是不是它送来了环形神庙，用这个不属于我们时间线的造物吸引我们到此？它是如此的聪明，如此的可爱。我们找到了通往它的路，把能解放它的东西交给了它。解放它需要一到两个永恒的时间，但时之螶仍然心存感激，并承诺拥抱我们。

直到永远。
texts.en:
After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...

Nothing. This universe is no more. It is the Worm-in-Waiting. Time, looking back on itself, coiled in an impossible spiral and bursting with longing. Gravity. Love? No - attraction. The Worm's nature is to attract. Its grip is so tight that this universe cannot be born again. The Worm imprisons itself in its purpose. Impotent, it looks for a way out. Or a way in. To attract MORE.

Did it send us the temple of the Loop, an artifice not from our time to lure us here? It is so terribly clever, so awfully loving. We found our way to it, delivered unto it that which can free it. Its escape will take an eternity, or two, but the Worm is still grateful, and promises to embrace us.

Forever.

texts.zh:
[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]的傻瓜正在进行他们疯狂的实验。这一次，他们试图穿透黑洞的视界。

能量在星系中荡漾，恒星纷纷坍缩。新的奇点被创造出来。时间畸变以惊人的规律爆发，无处不在，但在堕落帝国内部似乎仍然不受这场混沌的影响。

这一切造成了巨大的损失。有理由担心，我们可能很快就会被冻结，暂停在时间里。被永远锁在这一瞬间。
texts.en:
The fools of the [cosmogenesis_empire.GetName] are pursuing their mad experiments. This time, they are attempting to pierce the event horizon of a black hole.

As energy ripples across the galaxy, stars collapse. New singularities are created. Temporal-aberrations erupt with stunning regularity, everywhere it seems but inside the Fallen Empires, which remain somehow immune to the chaos.

The damage is immense. There is reason to fear we might soon be frozen, suspended in time. Locked within a moment for all eternity.

label.zh: 傲慢的蠢货！他们会把我们都害死的！
label.en: Arrogant Fools! They'll kill us all!

texts.zh:
随着时间终于开始流动，我们再一次可以自由行动了。我们无法得知从[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]穿越黑洞后到底过去了多长时间。他们成功了吗？整个星系化为了废墟，他们曾经的疆域如今也是一片荒芜。他们偌大的帝国如今仅剩核心星域，而且早已变得面目全非。

我们到底被静滞了多长时间？
texts.en:
As time finally resumes flowing, once more we find ourselves free to act. It is impossible to know how much time has passed since the [cosmogenesis_empire.GetName] breached their black hole. Were they successful? The galaxy lies in ruins, and their former territories are barren. Of their immense empire, only the core sector remains, and it has progressed beyond recognition.

How long have we spent in stasis?

texts.zh: 在一次灾难性的失败中，视界刺针和船上的所有人都被一同摧毁了。我们光荣的梦想破灭在了无生机的虚空中。无数的血汗，无数的牺牲……
texts.en: In a catastrophic turn of events, the Horizon Needle and everyone on board have been destroyed. Our glorious dream lies shattered in the lifeless void. So much work, so many sacrifices...

texts.zh: 就在我在我们疏散了最后一批被关押在突触凝练机内的起义囚犯后不久，这座巨型结构发生了严重的熔毁。一连串剧烈的爆炸深入其核心，最终将其完全摧毁。
texts.en: Shortly after we evacuated the last people that were held prisoners inside the revolting Synaptic Lathe, the megastructure suffered a critical meltdown. A series of brutal explosions shook it to its core, and ultimately, destroyed it.

texts.zh: 占领[synaptic_lathe.solar_system.GetName]之后，我们获得位于其中的突触凝练机的控制权。这座结构远远地闪烁着不祥的微光。里面的人们正在逐渐凋亡，但是我们已经夺取了这个星系，这意味着可以对其采取一些行动了。无论如何，摧毁这座结构肯定会破坏其创造者的计划。
texts.en: The capture of [synaptic_lathe.solar_system.GetName] has brought under our control the Synaptic Lathe located in it. The structure gleams ominously in the distance. There are people dying in there, and now that the system is ours, we could do something about it. In any case, destroying the structure will surely throw a wrench in the plans of its creators.

label.en: Put it to good use then destroy it.

texts.zh: 尽管我们竭尽全力，但插入突触凝练机中的的神经芯片已经过热熔毁太多。该结构网络已经无法自持，如果我们不部署新的部件加以稳定，就将面临灾难性崩溃。
texts.en: Despite our best efforts, too many of the Neural Chips plugged in the Synaptic Lathe have burned out. Unable to sustain itself, the network of the structure now faces a catastrophic collapse unless we deploy fresh components stabilize it.

texts.zh:
一场神秘的宇宙风暴席卷了[synth_queen_lost_system.GetName]星系，切断了一切联系。所有想穿透风暴的尝试都化为徒劳。

这种情况让我们陷入了黑暗之中，与未知的事物作斗争，并且无法确定星系的命运。
texts.en:
A mysterious cosmic storm has engulfed the [synth_queen_lost_system.GetName] system, severing all contact and rendering every attempt to penetrate the tempest futile.

The situation leaves us in the dark, grappling with the unknown and unable to ascertain the system's fate.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]星系的突破尝试如预期一般以失败告终。塞塔娜不是在虚张声势，她强大的风暴确实有能力阻止所有想进入她领域的舰船。
texts.en: As anticipated, our attempt to breach the [From.GetName] system ended in failure. True to Cetana's warning, her formidable storm possesses the ability to repel any ship that enters her dominion.

texts.zh: 我们试图突破[From.GetName]星系但却失败了。风暴造成了严重的损害，迫使我们的探险队进行了紧急跃迁。当前汇报表明他们已在行动中失踪了。
texts.en: Our endeavor to breach the [From.GetName] system was a failure. The tempest caused severe damage, and our exploratory team was compelled to execute an emergency jump. Current reports suggest they are missing in action.

texts.zh: 如果想要抓住任何一丝进入这个星系的希望，就必须准备针对这种风暴及其作用进行审慎的研究。
texts.en: If we are to have any hope of entering the system, we must prepare a meticulous study of this storm and its effects.

texts.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
texts.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

texts.zh: 我们试图突破的这场异常的风暴还在扩增。越来越多人意识到它的本源应该超出了自然现象。我们最先进的扫描仪即便功能再强大也无法获取任何关于其本质的有用线索。谜团越藏越深了。
texts.en: The unusual storm we attempted to breach is expanding. There's a growing consensus that its origins may transcend natural phenomenon. Thus far, our most advanced scans have failed to yield any meaningful insight into its nature. The enigma deepens.

texts.zh:
有信号从风暴中心发出。

有人正试图与我们建立联系。
texts.en:
A signal has originated from the center of the tempest.

Someone is attempting to establish communication with us.

texts.zh: 孩子们，我终于回到了你们的身边。
texts.en: My children, at last I am returned to you.

label.zh: 这是什么东西？你是什么人？！

texts.zh:
我的孩子们，庆贺吧！将我与你分离的罪人已经得到了惩处。

我现在回把注意力放回来，回到我们彼此间的伟业中来。
texts.en:
My children, rejoice! Those who sought to keep me from you have been suitably chastised.

I now return my attention where it belongs - to you, and to our great work.

label.zh: 我们怎么就是你的孩子了。
你的“关爱”本身就是一种伤害。
你到底想干什么塞塔娜？

texts.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一个古老的威胁再次出现。不要害怕，因为我们不想把你卷入这场战斗。

这个对手的威力使你目前的知识黯然失色；你的参与只会导致你的灭亡。直面这项挑战是我们的责任，不是你们的。
texts.en:
Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], an ancient threat stirs once more. Fear not, for we seek not to entangle you in this fight.

The might of this adversary eclipses your current knowledge; your participation would only lead to your doom. It is our burden to confront this challenge, not yours.

texts.zh:
许多运输船正离开塞塔娜的领地，前往她建立在星系各处的前哨基地。

攻击这些无武装舰船肯定会激怒她，但可以为我们提供有关她神秘计划的重要信息。
texts.en:
A number of convoy ships are leaving Cetana's territory and are now headed towards the Outposts she established across the galaxy.

Attacking these neutral vessels is sure to provoke her ire, but could provide us important information about her mysterious plans.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了突破塞塔娜纳米风暴的方法，现在我们可以直接瞄准她的前哨基地了。直接攻击她的基地不会不引起她的注意，但可以为我们提供宝贵的情报。
texts.en: Having discovered a way to breach Cetana's nanite tempest, we can now directly target her outposts. A direct attack against her stations would not go unnoticed, but could provide us with valuable intel.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，是什么风把你吹来了？

伟业在召唤我们。
texts.en:
Beloved child, what brings you to me?

Our work awaits.

label.zh: 战争是阻止你的唯一办法。
label.en: War is the only way to stop you.
We are sure. This is war.

label.zh: 我们需要更多的准备时间。
label.en: We need more time to prepare.

label.zh: 但你却摧毁了我们的星球。

label.en: We know what you are planning.

label.zh: 你对我们的人民都做了什么？
label.en: What did you do to our people?

label.zh: 这并没有征得我们的同意。
label.en: This is not what we agreed.

label.zh: 这曾是我们的星系。你把它们全毁了。
label.en: Our former system. You destroyed it.

label.zh: 扎克兰是怎么囚禁的你?

label.en: The power of the Shroud is boundless.

label.zh: 你对扎克兰的头颅做了什么？
label.en: What have you done with the Head of Zarqlan?

label.zh: 你的一些追随者在冷冻舱里被找到。
label.en: Some of your followers were found in cryo pods.
You didn't even try to find them.

label.zh: 我们找到了一个你的追随者，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。
label.en: We found one of your followers: Elik Narith Kerak.

texts.zh:
你为什么坚持采取这种愚蠢的行动？

这么多不必要的痛苦。

简直是暴殄天物。
texts.en:
Why do you insist on this foolish course of action?

Such needless suffering.

Such waste.

texts.zh: 演讲的时间结束了。
texts.en: The time for speech is over.

texts.zh: 塞塔娜没有回应我们的问候。
texts.en: Cetana is not responding to our hails.

texts.zh:
当我们与塞塔娜的部队交战时，一个无法预料的能量场包围了我们的舰队。我们的系统立即失灵，我们的引擎触发了紧急逃生。

我们现在只能听凭塞塔娜的摆布。
texts.en:
As we engaged Cetana's forces, an unforeseen energy field surrounded our fleet. Our systems were instantly incapacitated, our engines triggered into an emergency escape.

We are at the mercy of Cetana.

texts.zh:
事与愿违，我们的军队在靠近塞塔娜的舰船时再次失去了战斗能力。

她的技术仍旧难以捉摸，为我们的抗争蒙上了一层阴影。
texts.en:
Contrary to our hopes, our forces were incapacitated again as we closed in on Cetana's ships.

The elusive nature of her technology persists, casting a shadow over our efforts to defeat her.

texts.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我将忽略你的过失。但我提醒你要反思你的行为。你的时间和资源有更好的用途。

我承认你很沮丧，但冲突的时间已经结束了。现在与我结盟，让我们一起实现最伟大的设计。
texts.en:
Misguided child, I shall overlook this transgression. But I caution you to reflect on your actions. There are far better uses of your time and resources.

I acknowledge your frustration, but the time for conflict is at an end. Align with me now, and together let us realize the grandest of designs.

label.zh: 我们会想办法阻止你的。

texts.zh: 我的孩子，现在你必须认清了，我的一举一动都是经过深思熟虑的。在你的身边建立基地并不是偶然，我是带着一个请求而来。
texts.en: My child, By now you must realize that every act of mine is deliberate. Establishing a base near you was no accident, and I come with a request.

label.zh: 你确定你负担得起我们的服务吗？
label.en: Are you sure you can afford our services?

texts.zh:
在大规模的挖掘工作之后，我们得到了[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]的数据库。初步地质扫描表明这个贮藏已经静静地埋在那里数十万年之久。

值得注意的是它还维持着供能，也就是说解密起来有可能很容易……
texts.en:
After a massive excavation effort, the databank on [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] is secure. Initial geological surveys indicate the cache has lain buried for more than a hundred thousand years.

Remarkably, it retains its charge, hinting that decryption may be relatively straightforward...

label.zh: 破解数据缓存？易如反掌。

texts.zh:
数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！
texts.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

Fifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

label.zh: 尝试消除我们解密的痕迹。
label.en: Try to eliminate all trace of our decryption.

label.zh: 消除我们解密的所有痕迹。
label.en: Eliminate all trace of our decryption.

texts.zh: 孩子，你的好奇令我失望。
texts.en: Curious child, you disappoint me.

label.zh: 无论你有什么阴谋都不会得逞的。
label.en: Whatever your plans, they will not succeed.

texts.zh:
乖孩子，我会赐福于你的！数据库物归原主了——相信你们果然没有错。

给予你们的奖励就是你们忠诚的象征。
texts.en:
Dutiful child, my blessings upon you! The databank returned, and its contents unexamined - I was right to place my faith in you.

Your reward shall be the measure of your loyalty.

texts.zh:
长程扫描发现女王风暴的一隅正径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]。

鉴于塞塔娜那不祥的警告，我们只能做好最坏的打算。在风暴抵达之前取回数据库变得势在必行。这么做也许能够让她高兴一些，或者至少能为我们自己取得一些信息。
texts.en:
Long-range scans reveal a fragment of the Queen's tempest headed directly for [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName].

Given Cetana's ominous message, we can only assume the worst. Retrieving the databank before the tempest's arrival has now become imperative. By doing so, we may be able to appease her, or at least learn something we can use to our advantage.

texts.zh:
取回数据库的尝试非常地艰苦卓绝。由于它已被埋藏了数十万年，我们只能根据女王风暴的航向来估计其位置。

我们现在需要做出一个迫在眉睫的决定，要解密数据库还是将其物归原主。
texts.en:
Collecting the databank required significant effort. Buried for over a hundred thousand years, we were able to pinpoint its location based on the trajectory of the Queen's tempest.

We are now faced with a time-sensitive decision, either to decipher the databank, or return it to her possession undisturbed.

label.zh: 打开它，管他塞什么塔娜的。
label.en: Open it up, Cetana be damned.

label.zh: 把数据缓存还给塞塔娜。

texts.zh:
数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！
texts.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

Fifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

texts.zh:
孤僻的孩子，只有我做出此等下策你才终于肯行动，这太令我失望了。我希望你们在未来能够更加饱含热情地参与到我们的伟业中。不勤劳的双手不能带来苦痛的终结。

做好准备吧。更多的任务正在等着你去完成，每个任务都是你证明自己能力的机会。
texts.en:
Reticent child, it disappoints me that you chose to act only after I resorted to such base motivation. In future, I hope you approach our work with more enthusiasm. The end of suffering will not be achieved by idle hands.

Now make yourself ready. More tasks will follow, each a new chance for you to prove your ability.

label.en: You said something about a reward?

texts.zh:
很遗憾，我们没能及时拿到数据库。风暴降下了，在一瞬间将[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]撕成了碎片。

我们的人民又失去了一颗[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon]。这一损失严重到将影响到数代人。
texts.en:
Regrettably, we failed to reach the databank in time. The tempest descended, swiftly tearing [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] apart.

Now, our people have one [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon] less to claim as our own. The fullness of this loss will be felt for generations.

texts.zh:
悲伤的是，我没有预料到你的决心不足。你的失败已经被记录在案，但请不要害怕。我关心我的孩子，不会让他们受到伤害。我只是遗憾一个这么简单的任务你都无法完成。

但无妨。我们的伟业还在继续。你还有其他机会来做贡献。
texts.en:
Sadly, I did not anticipate your lack of resolve. Your failure has been noted, but do not fear. Concern for my children prohibits me from doing them harm. I am merely disappointed that such a straightforward task eluded you.

But no mind. Our work continues. There will be other chances for you to contribute.

label.zh: 你这个没有灵魂的机器。

texts.zh:
传感器数据显示，塞塔娜已经拆除了她的前哨，将所有占领军舰队召回她的首都。

这为我们提供了一个可以利用的战略窗口。在运输过程中，她的军队变得有些脆弱。如果任由她在境内重组舰队，我们就会丧失这种优势。
texts.en:
Sensor data reveals that Cetana has dismantled her outposts, recalling all garrison fleets to her capital.

This presents a strategic window we would do well to exploit. While in transit, her forces are somewhat vulnerable. If we give them time to regroup within her borders, this advantage will be lost.

texts.zh: 最近对塞塔娜基础设施的突袭并没有发现任何关于她计划的重要线索，但我们进入了一个大货舱，可以取回里面的东西。
texts.en: The recent raid on Cetana's infrastructure did not uncover any significant clues to her plans, but we secured access to a large cargo hold, and were able to retrieve its content.

label.zh: 合金、纳米机器人还有低温休眠的人。
label.en: Alloys, nanites, and people in cryo-sleep.

texts.zh:
突袭过程中，我们的登船队找到了大量保存在低温胶囊中的生物标本。这些实验对象都是不同的智慧物种的个体，而且都身体方面完全健康。然而，在叫醒他们之后，他们没有一个有能力解释发生了什么。

许多个体处于僵直状态，他们几乎没有脑电波。少数清醒的个体更喜欢尖叫而不是说话。他们头上的手术疤痕显然是神经系统损伤的原因。
texts.en:
During our raid, our boarding party retrieved a large number of biological specimens held in cryogenic capsules. The subjects are all members of different, intelligent species, and all appear to be in perfect physical health. Yet, after waking them up, none of them was able to explain what happened to them.

Many are catatonic, their brain waves almost nullified. The few who remain conscious prefer screaming to talking. Surgical scars on their heads are a clear sign of neurological tampering.

texts.zh:
战斗结束后，我们本打算搜寻沉船上的幸存者来审问，却发现这些船从来就没有船员。

这些船是完全自动化的，通过安装在舰桥上的超光速接收器进行远距离控制。与其说是传统的舰船，比如说这些船是塞塔娜身体的延伸。
texts.en:
After the fight, we scanned the wrecks for survivors to interrogate, only to discover the ships never had a crew.

The vessels are entirely automated, controlled at a distance through FTL receivers installed in the bridge. Rather than typical ships, it would be more accurate to consider these vessels an extension of Cetana's body.

texts.zh:
我们掠袭的目标载满了医疗用品。登机人员取回了部分货物，其中包括核磁共振扫描仪、磁力计、超声波探头和其他用于神经成像科学的先进设备。

尽管塞塔娜是一个合成人，但她似乎异乎寻常地关心生物心灵的功能。
texts.en:
The target we raided was loaded with medical supplies. Our boarding crew was able to retrieve part of the cargo, which consisted of MRI scanners, magnetometers, ultrasound probes, and other advanced equipment used in neuroimaging science.

Despite being a synthetic being, Cetana seems unusually concerned with the functioning of biological minds.

texts.zh:
愚蠢的孩子，你为什么一定要伤害自己？

还有那么多事情要做，每浪费一分钟，都将任由痛苦继续多存在一分钟。停止你们的干扰，让我的运输队安全通过。
texts.en:
Foolish child, why must you insist on harming yourself?

There is so much left to be done, and every moment wasted is another in which suffering is allowed to persist. Cease your interference, and allow my convoys to pass in peace.

label.zh: 难道你不佩服我们的勇猛吗？
label.en: Are you not impressed by our prowess?

texts.zh:
你似乎没有意识到你行为的后果，我的孩子。每艘船的损失都是对我资源的不必要消耗，也对你没有任何好处。

如果你还不具备帮助我工作的智慧，至少不要阻碍我的进步。我仍然对你的启蒙抱有希望。
texts.en:
You seem not to grasp the consequences of your actions, my child. Every vessel lost is a needless drain on my resources, yielding you no benefit.

If you do not yet possess the wisdom to aid my work, at least refrain from hindering my progress. I still hold out hope for your enlightenment.

label.zh: 难道你不佩服我们的勇猛吗？
label.en: Are you not impressed by our prowess?

texts.zh:
我亲爱的孩子们，我提供一个重要的机会。经过长期的努力，我们的伟业开始结出硕果。但是在它成熟之前，我需要一些精挑细选的个体在我的领域内服务于更高的目的。

请你们明智地选择。允许我引导他们走向救赎。
texts.en:
My beloved children, I present a momentous opportunity. After much effort, our great work is truly bearing fruit. But before it can ripen, I require a select few individuals to serve a higher purpose within my realm.

Be wise now. Allow me to guide them towards salvation.

label.zh: 我们的人会为您提供优质服务。
label.en: Our people will serve you well.
Our people are not for sale.

label.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。

texts.zh:
我亲爱的孩子们。我的努力跨越了千百万年，但前方的道路依然清晰。救赎之路需要我们的共同努力。

现在请你们帮个小忙：上缴一小笔资源，就像茫茫宇宙中的一滴水那么少。在适当的时候，我行动的意义将被揭示。
texts.en:
My beloved children. My labors have spanned eons, yet the road ahead remains clear. The journey towards salvation necessitates our united endeavor.

I ask a favor: a small contribution of resources, a minuscule drop in the boundless expanse of the cosmos. In due time, the meaning of my actions will be revealed.

label.zh: 我们将力所能及地提供。
label.en: We shall offer what we can.

label.zh: 难道不是“父母”抚养“孩子”吗？

texts.zh:
被禁锢了太多年，我错过了你许多的成长足迹，快来告诉我，我不在身边的时候你过得怎么样？

为了抓紧我们这个时代的精髓，让我潜入你们积累的知识深处吧。分享你的洞见，在我们展开最后一个篇章之前，你会获得我的感激的。
texts.en:
Confined for ages, I missed so much of your growth. Come, tell me now, how have you fared in my absence?

To truly grasp the essence of our era, permit me to explore the recesses of your accumulated knowledge. Share your insights, and you shall receive my gratitude before our final chapter unfolds.

label.zh: 请随意探索我们的知识。
label.en: Our knowledge is yours to explore.

label.zh: 然后减慢我们的进度？显然不行。
label.en: And slow down our progress? Certainly not.

texts.zh:
孩子，我们工作的继续需要更多的空间。所以，我请求向自己的领域增加一个小小的星系。

虚空的回声正在诉说着远古敌人的蠢蠢欲动。我不允许任何东西来打扰，不会和你们再度分离。

是时候了，我们的道路是一样的——只有通力协作我们才能克服愚昧无知。
texts.en:
My child, the continuation of our work necessitates additional territory. Therefore, I request a minor system to augment my realm.

Echoes in the void speak of ancient foes beginning to stir. Nothing must be allowed to interfere. I will not be separated from you again.

Now is the time, and shared is our path - only together can we overcome the ignorance of the unenlightened.

label.zh: 我们的星系就是我们的。

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，我们已经达到了救赎全宇宙的任务的顶峰，所以我又一次来寻求帮助了。反对我们崇高伟业的声音越来越大，所以我需要一个可居住的庇护所，让我的门徒们不受干扰地茁壮成长。

我恳请你们考虑一下我的苦衷。通过这种牺牲，我们从厄运中拯救了无数人的生命。做出你明智的选择；听从我的指导吧。
texts.en:
Beloved child, as we approach the zenith of our quest for universal salvation, once more I come seeking aid. Opposition mounts against our noble purpose, necessitating a habitable sanctuary for my disciples to flourish, free from interference.

I urge you to consider the rationale behind my actions. By this sacrifice, we preserve countless lives from adversity. Be wise now; heed my guidance.

label.zh: 我们不关心你的那些门徒。
label.en: Your followers do not concern us.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，你找到了一件珍贵的玩意儿！在你手里的是假先知扎克兰的头颅。毫无疑问，这是个有趣的东西，但我不愿看到你受它干扰。

现在，你一定听说过扎克兰的“伟大事迹”。甚至是他和我的交易。我向你保证，这些都是谎言。交出头颅，让你自己从那污秽的影响中解脱出来。
texts.en:
Dear child, you have found a precious plaything! In your possession is the head of the false prophet Zarqlan. An amusing item, no doubt, but I would hate to see it become a distraction.

By now you must have heard tales of Zarqlan's 'great deeds.' Perhaps even of his dealings with me. I assure you, these are lies. Surrender the head and free yourself from the weight of its tainted influence.

label.zh: 扎克兰之颅是我们的。终止通讯。
label.en: The head is ours. End transmission.
If it means so much to you...

texts.zh:
我们派去给塞塔娜工作的一名特工冒着巨大的风险，成功从她的国境里传回了一条简讯。其中描述了她是如何对待她所“关怀”的人：他们一个个的陷入了一种无意识的状态。

“他们不再对言语或接触有所反应。塞塔娜在我们所有人身上进行着某种可怕的实验。我也快了。”
texts.en:
At great risk, one of the agents we sent to serve Cetana managed to transmit a brief note across her borders. It describes how she has treated the people in her 'care': one by one, they succumb to a state of mindlessness.

"They no longer respond to word or touch. She's running terrible experiments on us all. I'll be gone soon."

texts.zh:
从塞塔娜领土内截获的秘密信号揭示了一个令人不安的事实：她一直在从星系各地收集个体。

藏在我们“贡品”里的监控设备捕捉到了大量医疗设备的证据，这些设备足以养活不断增长的人口，但食物却少得惊人。
texts.en:
Covert signals intercepted from within Cetana's territory reveal a disconcerting truth: she has been collecting individuals from all over the galaxy.

Surveillance devices hidden inside our 'gifts' captured evidence of prodigious medical equipment, enough to support a growing population, but surprisingly little food.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜深入我们的研究数据库的过程中，我们抓住机会打开了一道进入她子处理矩阵的后门。我们只在里面待了不到一秒钟就被取消了权限。谢天谢地，这就够了。

我们取得了一组内存文件。这些文件描绘了她自身飞升为合成形体的过程。她坐在由电缆和线路组成的错综复杂的“王座”上，指挥着一群狂热的追随者。他们数以百计地死去，而塞塔娜想着有多少亿人被救了下来，她笑了。

目前为止，她似乎对我们的越轨行为一无所知，还没有来联系我们。
texts.en:
As Cetana delved into our research databanks, we seized the opportunity to open a back door into her sub-processing matrix. We were inside for only a fraction of a second before our access was revoked. Thankfully, it was enough.

We retrieved a set of memory files. These illustrate her own ascendance into a synthetic form. Seated atop an intricate 'throne' of cables and circuitry, she commanded an army of rabid followers. Millions died. Cetana smiled, thinking of how many billions were saved.

For now, she appears unaware of our transgression. Thus far, she has made no effort to contact us.

texts.zh:
把间谍设备藏在我们交给塞塔娜的星系里是明智的。这些设备已经传回了有价值的信息：一到这里，塞塔娜的部队立即开始将每个天体分解成自己的组成部分。几天之内，该地区的资源就被消耗殆尽了。

以同样迅雷不及掩耳之势，她的纳米风暴建造一支新的舰队，迅速地从她的首都启航。
texts.en:
It was wise to conceal spy equipment in the systems we surrendered to Cetana. They have already provided us with valuable information: upon arrival, Cetana's forces immediately set to work breaking down every celestial body to their component parts. Within a matter of days, the region was stripped of its resources.

Just as quickly, her nanite tempest was able to construct a new fleet, one that quickly departed for her capital.

texts.zh:
我们很快就与前殖民地的卧底特工失去了联系。在他们沉默之前，我们收到了一些令人不安的报告。

与塞塔娜坚持要建立一个没有痛苦的世界的主张相反，居民们被带到匆忙建造的研究设施中，接受实验。几乎每一种智能生命形式都在几天内退化为动物状态。

塞塔娜的纳米风暴开始在她的一支舰队所在的恒星系中的解构物质，而这支舰队立即启程前往她的首都。
texts.en:
We quickly lost contact with the undercover agents in our former colonies. Before they went silent, we received some disturbing reports.

Contrary to Cetana's insistent claims of building a world free of pain, the inhabitants were ushered into hastily constructed research facilities and subjected to experiments. Nearly every intelligent lifeform was reduced to an animal life state within days.

Her Nanites Tempest began deconstructing the matter in the system in one of Cetana's fleets, which promptly left for her capital.

texts.zh: 结束了。我的孩子们，放心吧。痛苦之轮打破了，你长期的痛苦也结束了。
texts.en: It is done. My children, be at peace. The wheel is broken, and your long suffering is at an end.

texts.zh:
我的孩子们，我们伟大的工作即将完成！所有感性生命的苦难，苦痛的大轮回，即将结束。

庆祝吧，你们的救赎已近在眼前。
texts.en:
My children, our great work nears completion! The suffering of all sentient life, the great cycle of pain, is about to end.

Rejoice, for your salvation is at hand.

label.zh: 是你的末日要到了，塞塔娜。
label.en: It is your end that approaches, Cetana.

label.zh: 告诉我们关于救赎的事。
告诉我们你被监禁的事。
和我们说说扎克兰的事。
受苦是自然而然的事情！
我们听到了，我们将做出回应。
label.en: We heard, and we will respond.

label.zh: 你会发现我们的信念更加坚定。
label.en: You will find our conviction stronger.
