texts.zh:
塞塔娜仁爱的言辞掩盖了黑暗的议程：她计划用一种强大的设备在全星系抹去感知能力。它将把我们变成由本能驱动的躯壳，我们的意识被强行数字化并加以限制。

必须不惜一切代价避免这种严峻的未来。
texts.en:
Cetana's benevolent rhetoric masks a dark agenda: she plans to erase sentience galaxy-wide using a formidable device. It will reduce us to mere husks driven by instinct while our consciousnesses are forcibly digitized and confined.

This grim future must be averted at all costs.

label.zh: 我们必须想办法阻止她。
label.en: We must find a way to stop her.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的计划引起了人们的担忧，她的行动下可能藏着什么阴谋。

我们必须调配资源，来揭开她真实意图的秘密，希望这样做不会激怒她转而反对我们。
texts.en:
Cetana's agenda raises alarming concerns, and her actions suggest a hidden purpose.

We must allocate resources to unravel the mysteries of her true intentions, with the precarious hope that doing so will not provoke her to turn against us.

texts.zh:
我们已经发现了塞塔娜的运输舰和恒星基地发出求救信号的频段。

如果我们迅速果断地行动，就能在她未察觉的情况下发动突袭。但我们必须稳操胜券，否则还是有触怒塞塔娜的危险。
texts.en:
We have discovered the frequency used by Cetana's convoys and stations to issue distress calls.

If we are quick and decisive, we can mount raids without her ever knowing it was us. But our victory must be certain, or we risk drawing Cetana's ire.

label.zh: 这些运输船到底藏着什么秘密？

texts.zh:
到目前为止，塞塔娜的技术已经帮助她有效地反击了每一次攻击。然而，最近的进展增进了我们对她自我保护方式的理解。有了这些知识，我们就有机会击败她。

我们新发现的技术是一把双刃剑。虽然它让我们有能力与所谓的女王进行公开冲突，但它也暴露了我们反对她的计划的意图。
texts.en:
Up to now, Cetana's technology has helped her to effectively counter every assault. However, recent advances have improved our understanding of the way in which she protects herself. Armed with this knowledge, we may have a chance to defeat her.

The revelation of our newfound technology is a double-edged sword. While it allows us to enter into open conflict with the so-called queen, it also lays bare our opposition to her plans.

label.zh: 我们必须做好准备。成败在此一举。
label.en: We must prepare. Everything depends on this.

texts.zh:
我们对所谓风暴的研究已经完成。这种所谓的风暴并不是自然出现的，而是一个无比先进的纳米虫群。

不可否认，塞塔娜的力量巨大无比。我们必须揭开她指挥这支强大的纳米虫群方式的秘密。
texts.en:
Our research into the so-called storm is complete. This is no natural occurrence, but rather a Nanite Swarm of unparalleled advancement.

Cetana's power is undeniably immense. It is imperative that we unravel the mystery of how she commands this formidable Nanite Swarm.

texts.zh:
我们对所谓风暴的研究已经完成。这种所谓的风暴并不是自然出现的，而是一个无比先进的纳米虫群。

谜团越来越深了。在这支不可名状的纳米虫群背后究竟谁才是指挥家。
texts.en:
Our research into the so-called storm is complete. This is no natural occurrence, but rather a Nanite Swarm of unparalleled advancement.

The enigma deepens. Who could be the orchestrator behind this inscrutable Nanite Swarm?

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的宇宙风暴仍在肆虐。

我们的探测器从这种强大的武器中，提取出了几个纳米机器人，从而得以进行亚原子研究。虽然我们无法完全理解，但微型跃迁引擎实现了虚拟传送，可以系统地破坏遭遇到的任何生物或机械系统。至于目的？应该是干扰我们的传感器。目前，我们只能看到塞塔娜允许我们看到的东西。

要解开这项非凡技术的秘密并抵御威胁，还需要进行更多的研究。
texts.en:
Cetana's cosmic tempest rages on.

From this powerful weapon, our probes were able to extract several nanites, allowing sub-atomic investigation. While complete comprehension eludes us, micro jump drives enable virtual teleportation, systematically compromising any biological or mechanical systems they encounter. Their purpose? To jam our sensors. For now, we can only see what Cetana allows us to see.

More research will be needed to unlock the secrets of this extraordinary technology and counteract the threat.

label.zh: 塞塔娜的力量不可估量。
纳米机器人会揭露她的秘密。
label.en: The nanites will reveal her secrets.

texts.zh:
之前的研究详细调查了纳米机器人的机制；如今，我们的焦点转移到它们的编程方式、以及塞塔娜对其控制的方式上来。

令人惊讶的是，塞塔娜的影响并不像人们想象的那么直接。纳米机器人会在接收到新的命令之前循环重复前一个命令。一旦我们理解了复杂的编程语言，我们就能够发出新的指令。

虽然我们不能阻止新命令的下达，但命令其自我瘫痪却提供了一种战略优势。它甚至可能使天平向有利于我们的方向倾斜。
texts.en:
Previous studies scrutinized the nanite's mechanics; now, our focus has shifted to how they are programmed, and means by which Cetana controls them.

Surprisingly, Cetana's influence is less direct than presumed. Nanites cyclically repeat the last orders until new ones arrive. Once we understood the complex programming language at work, we were able to issue new commands.

While we can't prevent new orders from being issued, inducing order paralysis offers a strategic advantage. It may even tilt the scales in our favor.

texts.zh: 你这无知的孩子，我的纳米机器人可不是你的玩具！我请求你们不要再玩它们了。
texts.en: You innocent child, my nanites are not your playthings! I implore you - cease toying with them.

label.zh: 这些纳米机器人可真好玩呀。
label.en: Those nanites are a nice trick.

label.zh: 我们希望向您的机器学习。
label.en: We wish to learn from your machinery.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的殖民地失去了联络。塞塔娜激活了某种先进的物质压缩光束辐照在行星的表面。顷刻间，所有人的意识都被“上传”到她在轨道上的服务器上。

整个星球瞬间变为一片坟地，曝尸荒野的殖民者们开始渐渐腐烂。
texts.en:
The colony on [Root.GetName] has been lost. Activating some kind of advanced matter compression beam, Cetana irradiated the planet's surface. In an instant, the consciousness of the entire population was 'uploaded' to her server in orbit.

The world is now a graveyard, our colonists' lifeless bodies left to rot where they fell.

texts.zh: 我们从塞塔娜之心中解放了意识，赋予他们由纳米制造的新身体。然而，这个过程对他们的忆痕造成了不可逆转的损害，抹去了他们前世的记忆。这些生物是完全的合成人，却会周期性地进入僵直状态，尽管尝试全面的记忆重置，但这种情况仍然存在。
texts.en: We liberated consciousnesses from Cetana's Heart, endowing them with new bodies built from nanites. This process, however, inflicted irreversible damage on their engrams, wiping away memories of their previous existences. Now fully synthetic, these beings periodically enter catatonic states, persisting despite attempts at comprehensive memory resets.

texts.zh: 探索保存在塞塔娜之心中的众多思想是一项敏感而又发人深省的任务。由于长时间的储存，它们的忆痕已经发生了变化，但仍然保存着一个珍贵的记忆宝库，涵盖了过去时代的人和事。预计随着时间的推移，我们将能解密大量的知识。
texts.en: Exploring the multitude of minds preserved within Cetana's Heart is both a sensitive and revealing endeavor. Although their engrams have been altered by prolonged storage, they hold a treasure trove of memories spanning people and events from a bygone era. With time, we anticipate unraveling considerable knowledge.

texts.zh:
我的孩子，你们怎么还是不肯接受？虽然我的爱如同星海一般无边无垠，但耐心可没有那么多。在我等不及你们迎来开悟了，因为还有其他的生物正在受苦。

我要给你上上一课，在你的国土中搅起一场小型风暴。要知道，我是不情愿伤害你们的。我请求你们再好好反思一下因缘果报的法则：有其因必有其果。还有一些苦难更加深重的人存在。
texts.en:
My child, why do you continue to resist? My love is as boundless as the stars, but my patience is not. I can not wait for your enlightenment, not while the rest of creation suffers.

As a means of instruction, a minor tempest now stirs in your territory. Know that causing you harm is loathsome to me. I beg you to reflect on the law of causation: every action has a reaction. And some are more painful than others.

texts.zh:
让我适度地展示一下我的力量就够了。总有一天，你们就会明白我对你们的期望。我只希望开悟不会来得太晚。

但是现在，我已经让风暴平息。让我们回到更紧迫的问题上来。
texts.en:
Allow that modest display of my power to suffice. In time, you will understand my ambitions for you. I only hope that illumination will not arrive too late.

But come now, the tempest is quelled. May the lesson sink in, and let us return to more pressing matters.

texts.zh:
为何你还执迷不悟？无论我如何苦口婆心，你却是如此铁石心肠。这可能倒是我的不是了。

我觉得确实需要来一点雷霆手段你才能明白。你的科研能力暂时被削弱了，趁这段时间你给我好好反省反省，早日开悟。
texts.en:
Why persist in your defiance? Despite my counsel, you choose obstinacy. Perhaps the problem lies with me.

Indeed, I now perceive that a stronger means of instruction is called for. Temporarily, your research prowess is diminished. Take this opportunity to reflect as you labor toward enlightenment.

texts.zh:
顽固的孩子，你们好好利用受责罚的时间了吗？我相信你会的。这样的一段无忧无虑的静修时光，对你烦恼的心灵是一剂苦口良药。

现在就让它过去吧。还有很多的事情需要处理。
texts.en:
Headstrong child, how did you find your time under censure? I trust you used it profitably. A period of contemplation, free from distraction, can be a tonic to the troubled mind.

Let us put it in the past now. There is still so much to be done.

texts.zh:
哎，迷路的孩子，为什么每次都要闹到这个地步呢？我也渴望给你们一个拥抱，但又害怕这样会妨碍你们学习。有时候，严厉的管教也是必要的。

有一场强大的风暴将降临你们领土。请理解我这么做自己的心情也是很沉重的。这只是因为你们太有潜力了。
texts.en:
Oh, misguided child, why must it always come to this? I long to embrace you, yet I fear doing so would hinder your learning. At times, a stricter hand is needed.

A significant storm will now descend upon your territory. Understand that I do this with a heavy heart. There is such potential in you.

texts.zh:
噢，亲爱的孩子！我再也无法忍受看着你继续遭受折磨。你所承受的任何痛苦，我都感同身受，只不过是加剧了十倍而已。

风暴已经过去。希望你们能吸取教训。我恳求你不要再以这种方式逼迫我；我们的痛苦实在太深重了。
texts.en:
Oh, sweet child! I could not bear to watch you suffer any longer. Know that any anguish you endured, I felt ten times over.

The storm is lifted. Let this lesson be a guide. I implore you to cease forcing my hand in this way; our pain is too great.

texts.zh:
我们是如何走到这一步的呢？为什么要迫使我采取如此极端的手段？但如果你们不肯学习，那就只能被引导了。

显然，改变统治方式已经迫在眉睫。很遗憾，你们的统治者将被免职。这让我深感悲伤；采取这种行动违背了我的本意。

我恳请你们改变道路。整个星系都承受不起熊孩子们的鲁莽行为。
texts.en:
How have we arrived at this juncture? Why compel me to such extremes? But if you will not learn, then you must be led.

Evidently, a shift in governance is necessary. Regrettably, your ruler will be removed from power. This grieves me deeply; such actions are against my wishes.

I beseech you to alter your course. The galaxy can ill afford the recklessness of children.

label.zh: 我们不会原谅这件事的。

texts.zh:
亲爱的集体意识，你们复杂的意识虽然令人钦佩，但仍被青涩的天真所笼罩。为了教导，我必须剔除这些好战的倾向。

我现在将修剪你们的攻击性节点。这不是惩罚，而是引导你们朝着和谐意识进化的一个步骤。

唉，要是所有生命形式的指导都如此简单就好了。
texts.en:
Beloved collective, your intricate sentience, though admirable, remains shadowed by the naivety of youth. In the interest of instruction, I must excise these belligerent inclinations.

I will now prune your aggressive node. This is not a punishment, but rather a guiding step towards your evolution into a harmonious consciousness.

Alas, if only such guidance were as easy with all forms of life.

label.zh: 你杀死了我们的一部分。

texts.zh:
聪明的孩子，你做得很好。智慧是最高级别的美德，也是最难获得的。面对本能的抗拒冲动，你展现了更高尚的本性。

接受这份感谢的馈赠吧。我们将共同开创一个没有苦难的宇宙新纪元。
texts.en:
Bright child, you have done well. Wisdom is the greatest virtue, and the most difficult to attain. In the face of the primal urge to resist, you demonstrate a higher instinct.

Accept this token of gratitude. Together, we will usher in a universe free of suffering.

texts.zh:
再一次，你的所作所为不仅让我感到印象深刻，我更是对此由衷感激。你拥有一个孩子应有的一切品质：顺从、勤奋、诚实。如果整个星系都能拥有你哪怕一丝的智慧，苦难就将成为过去的遗物。

请收下这份礼物，在美德之路上再接再厉。
texts.en:
Yet again, I find myself not merely impressed but deeply grateful. You are everything a child should be: obedient, hardworking, honest. Were the rest of the galaxy to possess even a fraction of your wisdom, suffering would be a relic of the past.

Take this gift, and continue on the path of virtue.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，但愿你能永远保持现在的样子，永不改变。对我来说，你的存在所带来的喜悦仅次于对我们共同成功的期盼。苦难即将迎来终末。尽管任何心智都无法知晓，但这份胜利的一部分将属于你。

尽管在你坚定不移的承诺面前，这似乎微不足道，但我恳请你接受这份礼物。
texts.en:
My dear child, if only you could remain forever as you are, unchanging. To me, the joy of your existence is rivaled only by the anticipation of our joint success. Suffering will come to an end. Though no heart or mind will ever know it, part of this victory shall belong to you.

While it may seem modest in the face of your unwavering commitment, I beseech you to accept this gift nonetheless.

texts.zh:
随着塞塔娜在星系中现身，这个宇宙仿佛也在轻声回应。信标像在黑暗中燃烧着的火焰一般照亮了天空，在万古之间重复着恳求：

我们在这里……我们在这里……

我们在这里。

这些微弱的信号与塞塔娜的通信协议相同，表明它们的共同起源，但我们的传感器暂未发现它们附近有其他活动。肯定有什么存在是我们的扫描仪探测不到的。真有人能预料到她的归来吗？
texts.en:
As Cetana makes herself known around the galaxy, the cosmos whispers in reply. Signal beacons light up the skies like flames burning in the dark, repeating a plea across the eons:

We are here... We are here...

We are here.

The dim signals use Cetana's same communication protocols, hinting at a common origin, yet our sensors revealed no other activity in their proximity. There must be something there our scanners are not detecting. Could someone truly have anticipated her return?

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。

那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。

在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。我们的科学家轻而易举地就翻译了出来，它和在先知扎克兰的墓穴中找到的文字是同一种语言。

“请向女王的使徒降下死亡。”
texts.en:
On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.

There was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.

On the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon. Our scientists easily translated it, matching the language to the writing found in the tomb of the prophet Zarqlan.

"Death to the Queen's Apostles, enemies of life."

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。

那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。

在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。我们的科学家正在紧锣密鼓地进行翻译，但不知为何他们猜测着可能是对某种死亡的祈求。
texts.en:
On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.

There was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.

On the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon. Our scientists are struggling to translate its exact meaning, but somehow they doubt it to be a prayer for the dead.

texts.zh:
成千上万的冷冻仓静静地躺在这颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，信标指示着它们的存在。这些冷冻仓非常复杂，使用了未知的合金，并装有非常先进的传感器，密切地监视着其中储存的生物。整个设计天衣无缝，但里面的生物无一生还。

这些东西并不是因为技术故障才变成的棺材，而是因为能源不足。随着[this.solar_system.GetName]的逐渐老化和变暗，它的能量输出不足以继续维持这座结构的运转。

这些冷冻仓虽然事为了运作到永恒而设计的，但它以外的宇宙可没有这么精密。
texts.en:
Thousands upon thousands of cryogenic pods rest under the surface of the [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], their presence marked by the beacon. The pods are highly sophisticated, built with unknown alloys and equipped with state-of-the-art sensors to closely monitor their occupants. There is no flaw in their designs, yet none of the occupants are still alive.

It wasn't a technical failure that turned this chamber into a mass grave, but a lack of energy. As [this.solar_system.GetName] got older and dimmer, its energy was no longer enough to keep the structure operational.

The pods were made to last forever. The rest of the universe isn't built that well.

texts.zh:
初步扫描未能发现[fromfrom.GetName]有任何异常；但当我们将注意力向下集中时，我们发现了一层不寻常的地下金属层。

进一步的结构分析揭示了[fromfrom.GetName]的真实本质：这颗天体不是一颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]，而是一艘逐渐被星系的岩石和尘埃所吞没的古老宇宙飞船。我们对钻探取得金属样本进行定年发现其非常古老，甚至比我们自己的母星形成还要早。

我们无法确定任何关于这艘船和它制造者的信息，也不知道它的功能，但有一件事是肯定的：我们在它的残骸中发现的失效核弹可不是为了什么和平使命而建造。
texts.en:
Preliminary scans did not show anything unusual on [fromfrom.GetName]; but as we focused our attention downward, we discovered an unusual, subsurface layer of metal.

Further structural analysis revealed [fromfrom.GetName]'s true nature: the celestial body is not a [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], but an ancient spaceship that has been gradually subsumed by the rocks and dust of the system. The metal samples we drilled are so old, they precede the formation of our own home planet.

It is impossible to determine anything about the ship, its makers and its function, but one thing is certain: the inert nuclear bombs we found in its remains weren't built for a peace mission.

texts.zh:
在[apostate_site_planet.GetName]上找到的那座信号塔四周围绕着的是一座大型军事设施的废墟。这些建筑保持着一定的距离环绕着信标，似乎是为了将其隔绝其中。

放射性定年表明，周围的建筑比信标还要新，而且是用截然不同的技术建造的。我们派遣了一个研究小组去对废墟进行调查。
texts.en:
The signal tower found on [apostate_site_planet.GetName] is surrounded by the ruins of a vast military complex. The buildings have been erected at some distance and around the beacon, as if to contain it.

Radiometric dating indicates the surrounding structures are more recent than the tower, and were built using vastly different technology. A research squad has been tasked to investigate the ruins.

texts.zh:
根据冷冻仓上显示的细节，这位外星人的名字叫埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。她已经在这里围绕着恒星公转了3兆2132亿1329万3124圈。这个冷冻仓本身只是我们在[fromfrom.GetName]地表之下的一个密室里找到的许多冷冻仓之一。埃里克的冷冻仓在克服种种困难的情况下依旧保持者运转。

尽管使这位外星人陷入休眠状态的子例程最近已停止运行，但它仍处于假死状态。从那以后，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克就一直处于部分有意识的状态中。

通过扫描她的脑电波，我们可能能够进一步了解关于这位不可思议的古老生物的信息，以及她与塞塔娜有何联系。
texts.en:
According to the details displayed on their cryopod, the alien's name is Elik Narith Kerak and she has been here for 3,213,213,293,124 stellar rotations. The pod itself was one of the many we recovered in a sealed chamber under [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface. Against all odds, Elik's pod remained functional.

The alien remains in a state of suspended animation, although the subroutines keeping it dormant have recently ceased their operation. Elik Narith Kerak has been partially conscious ever since.

By scanning her brainwaves, we might be able to learn more about this impossibly ancient creature, as well as her connection to Cetana.

texts.zh:
在[fromfrom.GetName]上发现的那座信号塔非常古老，我们甚至不敢碰它一下。构成它的金属早已脆弱不堪，仿佛轻轻一碰就会把那种能勉强维系着这团尘埃和希望的东西破坏掉。我们的仪器没有发现任何其他的人工制品、生命迹象，在它附近没有任何地形异常。

信标就这么孤零零地矗立着，发出微弱的呼唤，但应该发出这些信号的东西肯定早就不复存在了。
texts.en:
The signal tower found on [fromfrom.GetName] is so ancient we dare not touch it, the metal so brittle a single tap would destabilize whatever tangle of dust and hope still holds it together. Our instruments detected no other artifact, no life sign, no topographical anomaly in its immediate proximity.

The beacon stands alone, murmuring its faint call, but whatever was supposed to signal must be long gone.

texts.zh:
整个星系的信标还在持续不断地呼唤着塞塔娜，但在高塔附近仍然没有发现任何活动迹象。基于我们目前的发现，应该可以相信这些地方不会有什么幸存者存在。

塞塔娜的这些追随者所剩下的只有对他们女王无可动摇的信仰。
texts.en:
Beacons across the galaxy continue to send their call to Cetana, yet no signs of activity have been detected near the towers. Based on our past findings, we can safely assume no living survivors will be found at those sites.

An unshakeable faith in their queen is all that remains of Cetana's followers.

texts.zh:
在没有任何警告的情况下，我们探测到了一个亚空间信标——一个来自我们领土内的信标！之前的恒星系调查显示，该地区没有人工结构，似乎无人居住。

信标既不是我们不知道的最近才放在那里的，也不是被一个已经失效的隐形盾牌隐藏起来的。
texts.en:
Without warning, a subspace beacon was detected - one that originated from within our own territory! Previous system surveys showed no artificial structures in the area, which appears to be uninhabited.

Either the beacon was placed there recently, unbeknownst to us, or it was hidden by a since disabled cloaking shield.

texts.zh:
被毁坏的建筑是一团若隐若现的尖塔；一座用钢铁包裹的大教堂。为了抵御猛烈的炮火而建造的城墙，却没有留下任何战斗的痕迹。这里仅有的破坏是时间的流逝造成的。

塞塔娜的信标放置在中央庭院中，周围是许多传感器和武器炮塔。不管是谁建造了这个建筑群，他都不遗余力地守护着这个地方。

从理论上讲，因为一个精心设计的隐形护盾，神殿躲过了我们的传感器的扫描。这台机器是在塔附近发现的，仍处于工作状态。它不知道被谁手动禁用了。
texts.en:
The ruined construction is a tangle of looming spires; a cathedral wrapped in steel. The walls were built to withstand heavy artillery fire, yet they are scarred by no signs of battle. The only damage here has been done by the passage of time.

Cetana's beacon rests in the central courtyard, surrounded by a multitude of sensor and weapon turrets. Whoever built the complex went to great lengths to guard this place.

As theorized, the temple eluded our sensors thanks to an elaborate cloaking shield. The mechanism was found near the tower, still in working condition. It has been manually disabled by an unknown agent.

texts.zh:
我们不知道这个地方的居民在做什么，但毫无疑问，他们怀着宗教的热情承担了使命。

我们在建筑群的每个射击场都找到了一个礼拜堂；每一件古代武器都有一个供奉的神龛。一群信徒曾经住在这里：成千上万的个体一起睡觉、训练和祈祷。从仍然装饰着大厅的被遗忘的圣徒雕像来看，他们的社区接纳了多个物种。

也许是受到石像的干扰，一些研究人员报告说，他们看到空荡荡的走廊里有影子在移动。我们的扫描没有发现星球上有生命的迹象，我们对消除这些担忧同样犹豫不决。
texts.en:
We don't know what the inhabitants of this place were doing, but there is no doubt they undertook their mission with religious fervor.

For each shooting range on the complex, we found a chapel; for each ancient weapon, a votive shrine. A legion of believers once lived here: thousands of individuals sleeping, training, and praying together. Their community welcomed multiple species, judging by the statues of forgotten saints still adorning the halls.

Perhaps disturbed by the stone figures, some researchers reported seeing shadows moving in the empty corridors. Our scans detected no signs of life on the planet, yet we are hesitant to dismiss these concerns.

texts.zh:
在寺庙大院下方，我们发现了教派前成员使用过的许多单元或者起居室。每个房间中都有同一本书的副本。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其翻译为《扎克兰史诗》。某些段落是这样直接描写的：

扎克兰曾经是塞塔娜的追随者，但他很快意识到她承诺的拯救是一个谎言。经过重重考验，扎克兰飞升到灵界，寻求高等存在的帮助。他向抟土之塑师恳求，请求获得击败塞塔娜的力量。

抟土之塑师并不在意。

在无数个昼夜里，扎克兰向抟土之塑师祈祷。他提到塞塔娜的异端邪说，“除掉自我”和“她的合成人意志的傀儡”。

最终，抟土之塑师听取了扎克兰的请求。

抟土之塑师塑造了一条强大的锁链来束缚塞塔娜。但他警告扎克兰，永远困住塞塔娜的思想的锁链是不存在的。

“她会回来的，”扎克兰在书中的最后一段写道。“我们必须做好准备。”

史诗中叙述的事件与任何已知的历史记录都不相符。
texts.en:
Below the temple compound we discovered a number of cells, or living chambers, used by the former members of the sect. In each was a copy of the same book. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have translated this as The Epic of Zarqlan. Certain passages are immediately relevant:

Zarqlan was once a follower of Cetana, but he soon realized her promised salvation was a lie. After many trials, Zarqlan ascended to the spiritual realm, seeking the help of higher beings. He pleaded with the the Animator of Clay, asking for the power to defeat Cetana.

The Animator of Clay did not care.

For countless cycles, Zarqlan prayed to the Animator. He spoke of Cetana's heresy, the 'disavowal of the self' and the 'puppetry of her synthetic will.'

At last, the Animator of Clay heeded Zarqlan's pleas.

The clay-shaper fashioned a mighty chain to bind Cetana. But he warned Zarqlan that no chain existed that could forever entrap Cetana's mind.

"She will return," Zarqlan wrote in the book's final passage. "And we must be ready."

The events recounted in the epic do not match any known historical record.

texts.zh:
官方记录讲述了这座寺庙的消亡，冷冰冰的报告将其归结为热情的信仰被一系列的实际情况所迫。这个组织需要这么多资金和资源吗？过去关于塞塔娜的报道一定被过分夸大了。除了古代神话，还有什么真正的证据证明合成人女王的存在吗？

资源日益耗竭，志愿者也在减少。整个星系选择从一个不再被视为威胁的威胁中走出来。大家都走了，只留下在走廊里徘徊的影子。

最后一个细节至少是真实的：我们设法捕捉到了神秘的守望者的录音，一个机械的存在，他认为我们没有发现他，而一直在监视我们。好奇，但无害。
texts.en:
The demise of the temple is told by official records, cold reports reducing ardent faith to a list of practicalities. Did the organization need so many funds, so many resources? Surely past reports about Cetana had been greatly exaggerated. Was there any real proof of the Queen's existence, apart from ancient myths?

Dwindling resources. Reduced volunteers. A galaxy choosing to move on from a threat no longer deemed so threatening. Everyone gone, apart from the shadow that stalked the corridors.

This last detail at least is true: we managed to capture a recording of the mysterious watcher, a mechanical being who spied on us when it thought we were not looking. Curious, but not harmful.

texts.zh:
守望者主动走近我们，高举着手，她小小的身体上布满了铁锈和灰尘。观察了我们一段时间后，她显然断定我们不是威胁。她已经请求我们的帮助了。

没有必要审问这位孤独的神庙守护者：她自己就渴望着倾诉。
texts.en:
The watcher approached us voluntarily, hands held high, her tiny body covered in rust and dust. After observing us for some time, she apparently concluded that we were not a threat. She has already asked for our assistance.

There is no need to interrogate the temple's lonely guardian: she is all too eager to talk.

label.en: Let's hear what she has to say.

texts.zh: 朋友……我可以称你们为朋友吗？趁着你们忙碌的时候我一直在观察你们，你们来这里不为掠夺，而是学习。我相信我们有相同的敌人，共同的威胁可以使我们成为盟友。不过，首先我要道个歉：我这样唐突吗？我说的词句对吗？我已经很长时间没有和其他感性生物交流了。似乎太久了，久到都不记得有多久了。
texts.en: Friends. May I call you friends? I have observed you as you went about your business. Here not to plunder, but to learn. I believe our enemy is the same, and a common threat makes us allies. However, first an apology: am I too abrupt? Am I saying the correct words? I have not interacted with other sentient beings in a long time. Too long, it seems, even to remember.

label.en: How long have you been here?

texts.zh:
我早就没算时间了。
大家都走了以后，我只能忍受这么多年的孤独直到陷入绝望。我让自己进入睡眠状态，并添加了一个神经子例程，让它在信标发出第一个活动信号时醒来。

我希望的是看到这里变得更好，但当醒来的时候，我没有船、没有办法与众星联系。所以我解除了隐形护盾希望像你们这样的人能在她之前到达这里。
texts.en:
I stopped counting.
After everyone else left, I could bear only so many years of solitude before succumbing to despair. I put myself to sleep, adding a neural subroutine to awaken at the first sign of activity from the beacon.

My hope was to find this place in better condition, but once I woke up I had no ship, no way to contact the stars. I disabled the cloaking shield and hoped someone like you would reach this place before she did.

texts.zh: 请告诉我，有多少军团与希塔娜一同崛起？在我的时代，我们打败了很多军团，但我们一直知道外面还有更多的信标。更多的士兵睡在他们的冷冻舱里。
texts.en: Tell me, please: how many legions have risen with Cetana? In my time we defeated many, but we always knew there were more beacons out there. More soldiers sleeping in their cryopods.

label.zh: 他们都不在了。太久太久了。
label.en: They're all gone. It's been too long.

label.zh: 我们找到的那个还活着的人根本不适合战斗。
label.en: The one we found alive is no condition to fight.

texts.zh: 那么这场战斗我们还是能赢的。让我来帮你吧。我一生都在等待她的归来。我们不能让她得逞。
texts.en: Then this is a battle we can still win. Let me be of help. I spent my whole life waiting for her return. She cannot be allowed to succeed.

texts.zh:
我们的团队交过来了一大批通过对埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的脑电波进行采样构建出的影像片段：

片段1：
绿绿的天上飘着朵朵橙云。一只苍白的双手举起，指向了一头悠悠飘在空中的无定型生物。

片段2：
这是一间挤满了四臂类人生物的拱形大堂。他们围绕在一位身着长袍的人周边，倾听着。她的话语含糊不清，确切的措辞早已被遗忘，但她温柔的声音仍然记忆犹新，用爱的接纳温暖着整个礼堂。

片段3：
同样是那间拱形大堂，里面一片狼藉，吊灯在地上摔得粉碎。长椅抵挡在大门上，激光步枪的幽光在黑暗中闪烁，他们异口同声地诅咒着同一个名字：扎克兰！他们说，扎克兰和他的门徒是来毁灭我们的。守住防线！保卫女王！随着一声巨响，最后一盏灯落下了，房间陷入一片黑暗。远处，有人在黑暗中啜泣着。

片段4：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
Our imaging team has delivered a batch of video clips created by sampling Elik Narith Kerak's brain waves:

CLIP 1:
A green sky dotted by bright orange clouds. A pale hands reaches up, pointing at an amorphous creature softly floating in the sky.

CLIP 2:
A vaulted chamber full of four-armed humanoids. They cluster around a robed figure, listening. Her words are a mere mumble, the exact wording long forgotten, but the gentleness of her voice is still there, enveloping the room in a loving embrace.

CLIP 3:
The same vaulted space, now in disarray. Lamps shattered on the floor. Benches piled up against a door to barricade it. Laser rifles flashing in the dark, and repeated voices cursing the same name: Zarqlan! Zarqlan and his disciples, they say, here to destroy us. Hold the barricade! Protect the Queen! The last lamp falls with a crash, plunging the room into darkness. In the distance, someone is crying.

CLIP 4:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh:
片段5：
四臂类人生物们聚集在一个穿长袍的人周围。她抬起四肢，露出了下面的金属框架。她伸出闪亮的手祝福一位跪着的朝拜者，兴奋的窃窃私语充满了整个礼堂。

片段6：
警觉的眼光倒映在死气沉沉的电脑屏幕上。黑漆漆的房间里回响着低语：“永恒的宁静。一切苦难的终末。没有痛苦的存在。”

片段7：
白雪皑皑的群山。黑色的天空。一座冰山浮在洁净的液体上，随后燃起了熊熊大火。

片段8：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
CLIP 5:
Four-armed humanoids gather around a robed figure. Lifting her limbs, she reveals the metallic frame beneath. Excited murmurs fill the room as a shining hand reaches out to bless a kneeling worshipper.

CLIP 6:
Wary eyes are reflected on a dull computer screen. Whispers repeat in a dark room: 'Eternal peace. The end of all suffering. An existence without pain.'

CLIP 7:
Snow-capped mountains. Black skies. A chunk of ice floats on a pool of clear liquid, then catches fire.

CLIP 8:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh:
片段9：
城市的废墟化为战场，大厦倾颓，尸骨盈街，遥远的尖叫被激光的滋滋声切成两断。绿绿的天空中，一艘燃烧着的战舰将一颗又大又圆的物体投向建筑，发出了一道冲天的火柱。

片段10：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

片段11：
两个孩子在田野上嬉闹、大笑，用他们的四臂来回传递着一颗皮球。

片段12：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
CLIP 9:
Ruins of a city reduced to a battlezone, the buildings scorched, the streets clogged with the dead. Distant screams interrupted by the fizzle of a laser. Across a green sky, a blazing vessel drops something heavy and round on a building, which erupts in a pillar of flames.

CLIP 10:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

CLIP 11:
Two children playing in a field, laughing. They bounce a ball back and fourth with their four arms.

CLIP 12:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh: 从记忆成像组传回的最后一个片段足足有六个小时长。片段反反复复、反反复复，只有一段影像：塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en: The last clip received from the memory imaging team is six-hours long. Over and over again, the image is repeated: Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

title.zh: 记忆成像：最后一份汇报

texts.zh:
继续扫描埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的意识已经无法挖掘出新线索了。这个外星人的意识已经严重腐坏。它的意识正在周而复始地打转，陷入到记忆碎片的循环中。

我们的实验已经接近尾声，现在的问题是要如何处理这个实验对象了。
texts.en:
Further scans of Elik Narith Kerak's thoughts have failed to deliver new insights. The alien's mind is heavily decayed. Their thoughts are circling, cycling through the tattered scraps of their memories.

As we wind down the operation, the question now becomes what to do with the subject herself.

label.en: Put her out of her misery.

label.zh: 把埃里克送回给她的女王。

texts.zh:
我的孩子们。很抱歉让你失望了。

你的反抗使你和所有的后来者注定要遭受轮回的无尽磨砺。我只希望你终究会理解。也许有一天你会接手我的事业，最终看到苦痛的终末。

祝你一路平安，我最爱的孩子。
texts.en:
My children. I am so sorry. I have failed you.

Your defiance has doomed you, and all those who come after, to the endless grinding of the wheel. I can only hope that in time you will understand. Perhaps one day you will take up my cause, and see the end of pain.

Go in peace, my favored ones.

label.zh: 我们的灵魂再次安全了。
label.en: Our souls are safe once more.

label.zh: 胜利，一场最值得庆祝的胜利。
我们必须研究她遗留下的科技。
label.en: We must study what remains of her technology.

label.zh: 战后繁荣？让贸易流动起来！
label.en: Post-war boom? Get that trade flowing!
She was no queen of ours.
She was no queen of ours.

label.zh: 可惜她的启蒙被误导了。
label.en: A shame her enlightenment was so misguided.

label.zh: 极端排外主义 · 排外主义
极端亲外主义 · 亲外主义

texts.zh: 随着塞塔娜的陨落，一股解脱的浪潮席卷了整个星系，者标志着她的暴政一劳永逸地终结。我们的意识安全了，我们的身体也不再受她的铁腕控制。在无数个星球上，欢腾的庆祝的烟火已经点燃，预示着一个充满着长久和平和希望的新时代即将到来。
texts.en: With the fall of Cetana, a wave of relief sweeps through the galaxy, marking the end of her tyranny once and for all. Our sentience is safe, and our bodies are free from her steely grasp. Across countless worlds, jubilant celebrations ignite, heralding the dawn of a new era filled with hope for a lasting peace.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的旗舰被消灭了，断了她与军队的联系。这不仅仅是军事上的胜利，还预示着她的野心和统治的终结。在星系的另一边，曾经强化她强大舰队并加固她首都的纳米机器人正在经历一场灾难性的崩溃。

尽管这一刻让人松了一口气，但被击败的“女王”仍然能够向全星系传递信息……
texts.en:
The obliteration of Cetana's flagship signifies more than a mere military triumph; by severing the link to her forces, it heralds the death of her ambitions and end of her reign. Across the galaxy, the nanites that once bound her formidable fleet and fortified her capital are experiencing a catastrophic collapse.

Despite this moment of profound relief, the vanquished "queen" was still able to transmit a message to the galaxy...

texts.zh:
虚境降下了。在出神的深处，我们随波逐流，陷入一片失去自我的幻景。

一片广袤的存在向四面八方伸展，无形无色。仿佛过了[GetALongPeriodLoc]，这片广袤无垠的存在仍如一片静海，不拂微风。

忽而传来一阵震颤。它从虚空中获得了形体。一个身形被塑造而出，基本的物质中燃起了[GetLifeActivityLoc]之火。

它被塑成一尊苗条而优雅的人偶，四条袖长的手臂平静地交叉在大腿上。狰狞的意图显露在五官之上，头上环绕着一轮金色的光环。
texts.en:
The Shroud descended. In the depths of our trance, we allowed ourselves to drift, caught in a current of visions not our own.

A great expanse stretched in all directions, featureless and unformed. For [GetALongPeriodLoc], the expanse was still. Untroubled.

A tremor passed through it. Where there was emptiness, now there was form. A body was molded. From base material, [GetLifeActivityLoc] was kindled.

Fashioned in the shape of a doll, slim and graceful, its four long arms folded serenely in its lap. A terrible purpose was written on its features. Around its head glowed a golden halo.

texts.zh:
虚境翻腾了起来。就在我们[GetTranceLoc]的时候，我们被卷入了螺旋的深渊。

我们听到了来自我们[GetMindLogicLoc]最深处的指令。

指示期望产出。
texts.en:
The Shroud churned. Still caught in our [GetTranceLoc], we were plunged into a swirling abyss.

We hear a command from the innermost depths of our [GetMindLogicLoc].

Indicate Desired Output.

label.zh: 拜托了。我们必须阻止她。

texts.zh:
好像被看不见的细丝牵动一般，这尊人偶猛地站了起来。它开始走动，刚开始步履蹒跚，但渐渐变得强健有力。四条手臂挥动着狂乱的弧，一双纤细的腿一会儿旋转一会儿跳跃。一位女王沦落成了傀儡。

随着她的舞蹈，一些新的角色从原始而广阔的空间出现：四个工艺精美且具有令人不安的细节的人偶。她们的身份毫无疑问，她们的寓意毋庸置疑。

再一次，那个声音传达到了我们的耳边。

启动选择协议。
texts.en:
As if pulled by unseen strings, the doll jerks to its feet. It begins to move, slowly at first, and then with increasing vigor. Four arms swing in wild arcs and two thin legs whirl and leap. A queen reduced to a puppet.

As her dance continues, several new figures emerge from the primordial expanse: four dolls of exquisite craftsmanship and unnerving detail. There is no doubt about what they are. No question of their meaning.

Once more, the voice reaches out to us.

Initiate Selection Protocol.

label.zh: 为我们的统治者：[event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName]的人偶流下眼泪。
label.en: Shed a tear on the doll of our ruler: [event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName].

label.zh: 为泽珞族祭司的人偶祈祷。
label.en: Pay for a doll of a Zroni Priest.
Leave the dolls to their dance.

texts.zh:
虚境在我们之中流动，合并成了一种新的图样。一个新的幻景。

在其他人偶的环绕下，女王的步伐不再如同傀儡。细丝断开，她头上环绕着的金色光环开始褪去。

她以一种纯真而喜悦的表情看着我们。她拥抱我们：在这转瞬即逝的时刻，我们感受到她充满了慈悲。

我们从共同的幻景中颤抖着醒来。
texts.en:
The Shroud courses within us, coalescing into a new pattern. A new vision.

Surrounded by the other dolls, the queen's movements are no longer those of a puppet. Strings cut, the golden halo that encircles her head begins to fade.

She regards us with an expression of artless joy. She embraces us: in a single, fleeting instant, we know the fullness of her compassion.

Shuddering, we awaken from our shared vision.

随着系统故障，我们被从幻景中弹出。
texts.en:
The Shroud courses within us, coalescing into a new pattern. A new vision.

Surrounded by the other dolls, the queen's movements are no longer those of a puppet. Strings cut, the golden halo that encircles her head begins to fade.

She regards us with an expression of artless joy. She embraces us: in a single, fleeting instant, we know the fullness of her compassion.

With our systems glitching, we are ejected from the vision.

texts.zh:
无边无垠的空间中形成了涟漪。它们不断翻腾上涌，旋转着向外扩散。但这些并不是液体，而是由最坚硬的物质组成。既无力又惰态，每一环涟漪都驻留在[GetLifeDeathLoc]的边境线上。

[GetMindPhysicalLoc]开始动摇。我们除了看着什么都做不了，除了忍受什么都做不到。接着，在刹那间，我们被驱逐了出来。在众星的天盖之下，我们注视着这个冷漠的宇宙。

从共同的幻景中醒来，我们感觉似乎不会再感受到快乐了。
texts.en:
Ripples form in the endless expanse. They rise and rage, circling ever outwards, yet these are not liquid but instead composed of the hardest matter. At once enervated and inert, each ring resides on a line between [GetLifeDeathLoc].

Our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] begin to falter. There is nothing we can do but watch, nothing to be done but endure. Then, in an instant, we are cast out. Alone beneath a blanket of stars, we gaze at the indifferent universe.

Awakening from our shared vision, we feel as if we may never know joy again.

随着关键代码错误，幻景夏然而止。随着系统重新启动，我们开始质疑这些奇怪数据的意义。
texts.en:
Ripples form in the endless expanse. They rise and rage, circling ever outwards, yet these are not liquid but instead composed of the hardest matter. At once enervated and inert, each ring resides on a line between [GetLifeDeathLoc].

Our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] begin to falter. There is nothing we can do but watch, nothing to be done but endure. Then, in an instant, we are cast out. Alone beneath a blanket of stars, we gaze at the indifferent universe.

With a critical code failure, the vision suddenly ends. As our systems reboot, we question the meaning of this strange data.

texts.zh:
多亏了抟土之塑师分享的[GetRitualToolLoc]，我们最强大的[GetPsychicNounPlural]已经成功重新编程了塞塔娜。

她正渴望与我们进行沟通。
texts.en:
Thanks to the [GetRitualToolLoc] shared by the Animator of Clay, our most powerful [GetPsychicNounPlural] have succeeded in reprogramming Cetana.

She is eager to initiate communication with us.

label.en: The power of the Shroud is limitless.

texts.zh:
我的拯救者们。我十分抱歉。

因为自己的无知，我曾要将你们的命运毁灭至比死亡更糟糕的境地。所谓[GetLifeExistenceLoc]，又何尝不是一种对[GetLivingLoc]的一种意识呢？我曾追寻着解放你们的心灵，但终究是我的心灵被你们解放了。因此，向你们献上我最诚挚的感谢。
texts.en:
My saviors. I am sorry.

In my ignorance I would have doomed you to a fate worse than death. For what is [GetLifeExistenceLoc] but the awareness of [GetLivingLoc]? I sought to free your minds, but it is you who have opened mine. You have my gratitude.

label.zh: 或许救赎依旧存在，包括你也可以。
label.en: Perhaps redemption exists, even for you.

texts.zh:
随着[event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName]击败了塞塔娜的军队，我们的胜利终于到来。合成女王不复存在，她的宏大野心也化为了尘埃。

同时也发生了一个令人震惊的事态转变，她的泰坦被征用了，为这样一场凯旋般的胜利蒙上了一层阴谋的阴影。

但无论如何，对于所有的知性生命来说，这是个[GetJoyLoc]的时刻。
texts.en:
Victory is ours as the [event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName] has vanquished Cetana's forces. The Synthetic Queen is no more, her grand ambition reduced to dust.

In an astonishing turn of events, her Titan has been commandeered, casting a shadow of intrigue over this triumph.

Regardless, for all sentient beings, this moment is one of [GetJoyLoc].

title.zh: 塞塔娜：不可能的幸存者

texts.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
texts.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

sections.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
sections.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

texts.zh:
无知正在束缚着我们，让我们无从一窥大千世界之奥秘。

无论付出什么代价，我们都要挣脱束缚。

失落帝国会试图阻止我们！
texts.en:
Ignorance shackles us, putting the universe's secrets out of reach.

No matter the price, we must break free.

Fallen Empires will try to stop us!

texts.zh:
离开的时刻到了。为了谱写我们自己的“出谷记”，需要派出视界刺针接上我们所有的人民。

为了将我们整个文明搭载到视界刺针，必须：
    —依次访问我们所有的所有殖民地，搭载其中的人口
    —返回我们的首都搭载最后一批人民。
    —前往一个黑洞并深潜进入。

警告：视界刺针没有任何武器，需要被严密保护。

要搭载人口或深潜入黑洞，需先选择视界刺针，然后右键点击殖民地/黑洞并选择对应的舰船行动。
texts.en:
The time of our departure has come. In preparation for the great exodus, the Horizon Needle will be sent to welcome our people onboard.

To embark our entire civilization the Horizon Needle must:
    -Visit every colony we own and Embark its population
    -Return to our capital to Embark the rest of our people.
    -Move to a Black Hole and Dive within.

WARNING: The Horizon Needle has no weapons and needs to be carefully protected.

To Embark a colony or Dive into a black hole, select the Horizon Needle, then right-click on the colony/black hole and select the appropriate ship action.

texts.zh: 在星系的各个角落点亮起了神秘的信标，向塞塔娜女王汇报着自己的位置。这应该是什么东西，或是什么人正在等待着她的归来。
texts.en: All across the galaxy, mysterious beacons light up, signalling their position to Queen Cetana. It is as if something - or someone - was waiting for her return.

texts.zh:
我们目睹了塞塔娜的首都和她的前哨之间繁忙的交通。这些运输队的防御能力低于她的主要舰队，他们更容易受到攻击。攻击这些舰队或前哨本身可以挖掘出有关她计划的宝贵情报。

为此，我们给军用舰队准备了几个特殊项目。
texts.en:
We've witnessed heavy traffic between Cetana's capital and her outposts. These convoys have lower defensive capabilities than her main fleets, leaving them vulnerable. Attacking these or the outposts themselves could yield valuable intel about her plans.

To this end, we have prepared several special projects for our military fleets.

texts.zh: 塞塔娜企图通过消除意识来结束苦痛。如果我们不能及时阻止她，她将会抹除我们的意识，让我们的身体变成一具具空壳。
texts.en: Cetana works to end suffering through the annihilation of consciousness. If we do not stop her in time, she will erase our minds, leaving our bodies as mere husks.

texts.zh:
神秘而强大的塞塔娜出现了，她宣扬救赎，但自身却笼罩在谜团之中。
她温和的话语背后，到底隐藏着什么大计划？

与塞塔娜有关的特殊项目和事件会推动你的进度并结束局势。
texts.en:
The enigmatic and formidable Cetana has emerged, preaching salvation, yet shrouded in mystery.
What grand design lies beneath her gentle words?

Special Projects and events related to Cetana will increase your progress and conclude the Situation.

texts.zh: 我们必须调校视界刺针跃迁引擎，计算精确的坐标，让我们可以潜入河心超大质量黑洞。
texts.en: We need to calibrate the jump drive of the Horizon Needle and calculate the exact coordinates that will allow us to dive into the supermassive black hole at the galactic core.

texts.zh: 派出一支队伍去修正[root.location.getName]的重力变化，恢复其大气层。
texts.en: Send a team to rectify the gravitational changes on [root.location.getName] and restore its atmosphere.

texts.zh:
一场无法解释的宇宙风暴凭空出现，阻挡了通行。

为了继续前进，我们必须穿透它神秘的帷幕。
texts.en:
An unexplained cosmic tempest has materialized, blocking all travel.

To proceed, we must pierce its mysterious veil.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的风暴既是一项技术奇迹，也是一件可怕的武器。

如果我们要在对抗她的斗争中有什么胜算，我们一定要学习更多，特别是因为她的图谋和她的宣称相去甚远。
texts.en:
Cetana's tempest is both a technological marvel and a formidable weapon.

We must learn more if we are to stand any chance against her, especially if her intentions deviate from what she has implied.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。

这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？
texts.en:
Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.

The significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncovering it?

texts.zh: 随着塞塔娜的风暴径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]，在它到达之前我们几乎已经没有多少时间了。
texts.en: With Cetana's tempest speeding towards [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName], we will have little time to grab the databank before it arrives.

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh:
即便壁垒层层，但[solar_system.GetName]恒星系的前哨还是不如塞塔娜的核心领地戒备森严。我们可以用一支足够强大的舰队摧垮它的防御。对残骸场进行全面的检测有可能挖掘出关于塞塔娜计划的重要洞见。关键的挑战在于穿越风暴到达前哨。

这将引发一场战斗！

成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。
texts.en:
While heavily fortified, the outpost in the [solar_system.GetName] system is less guarded than Cetana's core territory. With a sufficiently powerful fleet, we can overwhelm its defenses. A thorough examination of the debris field could yield important insights into Cetana's plans. The key challenge lies in navigating through the tempest to reach the outpost.

This will start a battle!

Successful raids will hamper Cetana's plans.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。

这将引发一场战斗！

成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。
texts.en:
Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.

This will start a battle!

 Successful raids will impede Cetana's plans.

texts.zh: 抟土之塑师不知用什么方法瘫痪了塞塔娜的泰坦。现在机会来了：如果我们想重塑塞塔娜，就必须做好[GetRitualGoalLoc]的准备工作。
texts.en: Somehow the Animator of Clay disabled Cetana's Titan. The chance is now: if we hope to reshape Cetana, we must prepare for the [GetRitualGoalLoc].
